1.zh: 亚当[生]塞特；塞特[生]以挪士；
1.en: Adam, Seth, Enosh,

1.zh: 以挪士[生]该南；该南[生]玛勒列；玛勒列[生]雅列；
1.en: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,

1.zh: 雅列[生]以诺；以诺[生]玛土撒拉；玛土撒拉[生]拉麦；
1.en: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

1.zh: 拉麦[生]挪亚；挪亚[生]闪、含、雅弗。
1.en: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

1.zh: 雅弗的儿子是歌篾、玛各、玛代、雅完、土巴、米设、提拉。
1.en: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

1.zh: 歌篾的儿子是亚实基拿、低法、陀迦玛。
1.en: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.

1.zh: 雅完的儿子是以利沙、他施、基提、多单。
1.en: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

1.zh: 含的儿子是古实、麦西、弗、迦南。
1.en: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

1.zh: 古实的儿子是西巴、哈腓拉、撒弗他、拉玛、撒弗提迦。拉玛的儿子是示巴、底但。
1.en: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

1.zh: 古实生宁录；他为世上英雄之首。
1.en: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one on the earth.

1.zh: 麦西生路低人、亚拿米人、利哈比人、拿弗土希人、
1.en: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

1.zh: 帕斯鲁细人、迦斯路希人、迦斐托人；从迦斐托出来的有非利士人。
1.en: Pathrusim, Casluhim (where the Philistines came from), and Caphtorim.

1.zh: 迦南生长子西顿，又生赫
1.en: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, Heth,

1.zh: 和耶布斯人、亚摩利人、革迦撒人、
1.en: the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,

1.zh: 希未人、亚基人、西尼人、
1.en: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,

1.zh: 亚瓦底人、洗玛利人，并哈马人。
1.en: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

1.zh: 闪的儿子是以拦、亚述、亚法 撒、路德、亚兰、乌斯、户勒、基帖、米设。
1.en: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.

1.zh: 亚法撒生沙拉；沙拉生希伯。
1.en: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.

1.zh: 希伯生了两个儿子：一个名叫法勒，因为那时人就分地居住；法勒的兄弟名叫约坍。
1.en: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.

1.zh: 约坍生亚摩答、沙列、哈萨玛非、耶拉、
1.en: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

1.zh: 哈多兰、乌萨、德拉、
1.en: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

1.zh: 以巴录、亚比玛利、示巴、
1.en: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,

1.zh: 阿斐、哈腓拉、约巴。这都是约坍的儿子。
1.en: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

1.zh: 闪[生]亚法撒；亚法撒[生]沙拉；
1.en: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,

1.zh: 沙拉[生]希伯；希伯[生]法勒；法勒[生]拉吴；
1.en: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

1.zh: 拉吴[生]西鹿；西鹿[生]拿鹤；拿鹤[生]他拉；
1.en: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

1.zh: 他拉[生]亚伯兰，亚伯兰就是亚伯拉罕。
1.en: Abram (also called Abraham).

1.zh: 亚伯拉罕的儿子是以撒、以实玛利。
1.en: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

1.zh: 以实玛利的儿子记在下面：以实玛利的长子是尼拜约，其次是基达、押德别、米比衫、
1.en: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

1.zh: 米施玛、度玛、玛撒、哈达、提玛、
1.en: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,

1.zh: 伊突、拿非施、基底玛。这都是以实玛利的儿子。
1.en: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

1.zh: 亚伯拉罕的妾基土拉所生的儿子，就是心兰、约珊、米但、米甸、伊施巴、书亚。约珊的儿子是示巴、底但。
1.en: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

1.zh: 米甸的儿子是以法、以弗、哈诺、亚比大、以勒大。这都是基土拉的子孙。
1.en: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.

1.zh: 亚伯拉罕生以撒；以撒的儿子是以扫和以色列。
1.en: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

1.zh: 以扫的儿子是以利法、流珥、耶乌施、雅兰、可拉。
1.en: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

1.zh: 以利法的儿子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦、基纳斯、亭纳、亚玛力。
1.en: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.

1.zh: 流珥的儿子是拿哈、谢拉、沙玛、米撒。
1.en: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

1.zh: 西珥的儿子是罗坍、朔巴、祭便、亚拿、底顺、以察、底珊。
1.en: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

1.zh: 罗坍的儿子是何利、荷幔；罗坍的妹子是亭纳。
1.en: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.

1.zh: 朔巴的儿子是亚勒文、玛拿辖、以巴录、示非、阿南。祭便的儿子是亚雅、亚拿。
1.en: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

1.zh: 亚拿的儿子是底顺。底顺的儿子是哈默兰、伊是班、益兰、基兰。
1.en: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

1.zh: 以察的儿子是辟罕、撒番、亚干。底珊的儿子是乌斯、亚兰。
1.en: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

1.zh: 以色列人未有君王治理之先，在以东地作王的记在下面：有比珥的儿子比拉，他的[京]城名叫亭哈巴。
1.en: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

1.zh: 比拉死了，波斯拉人谢拉的儿子约巴接续他作王。
1.en: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.

1.zh: 约巴死了，提幔地的人户珊接续他作王。
1.en: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

1.zh: 户珊死了，比达的儿子哈达接续他作王。这哈达就是在摩押地杀败米甸人的，他的[京]城名叫亚未得。
1.en: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.

1.zh: 哈达死了，玛士利加人桑拉接续他作王。
1.en: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

1.zh: 桑拉死了，大河边的利河伯人扫罗接续他作王。
1.en: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.

1.zh: 扫罗死了，亚革波的儿子巴勒·哈南接续他作王。
1.en: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

1.zh: 巴勒·哈南死了，哈达接续他作王。他的[京]城名叫巴伊，他的妻子名叫米希她别，是米·萨合的孙女，玛特列的女儿。
1.en: Baal Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

1.zh: 哈达死了，以东人的族长有亭纳族长、亚勒瓦族长、耶帖族长、
1.en: Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,

1.zh: 亚何利巴玛族长、以拉族长、比嫩族长、
1.en: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

1.zh: 基纳斯族长、提幔族长、米比萨族长、
1.en: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

1.zh: 玛基叠族长、以兰族长。这都是以东人的族长。
1.en: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.

2.zh: 以色列的儿子是吕便、西缅、利未、犹大、以萨迦、西布伦、
2.en: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,

2.zh: 但、约瑟、便雅悯、拿弗他利、迦得、亚设。
2.en: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

2.zh: 犹大的儿子是珥、俄南、示拉，这三人是迦南人书亚女儿所生的。犹大的长子珥在耶和华眼中看为恶，耶和华就使他死了。
2.en: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah, which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight; and he killed him.

2.zh: 犹大的儿妇她玛给犹大生法勒斯和谢拉。犹大共有五个儿子。
2.en: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

2.zh: 法勒斯的儿子是希斯 、哈母勒。
2.en: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

2.zh: 谢拉的儿子是心利、以探、希幔、甲各、大拉，共五人。
2.en: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five of them in all.

2.zh: 迦米的儿子是亚干，这亚干在当灭的物上犯了罪，连累了以色列人。
2.en: The son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.

2.zh: 以探的儿子是亚撒利雅。
2.en: The son of Ethan: Azariah.

2.zh: 希斯 所生的儿子是耶拉篾、兰、基路拜。
2.en: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.

2.zh: 兰生亚米拿达；亚米拿达生拿顺。拿顺作犹大人的首领。
2.en: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

2.zh: 拿顺生撒门；撒门生波阿斯；
2.en: and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,

2.zh: 波阿斯生俄备得；俄备得生耶西；
2.en: and Boaz became the father of Obed, and Obed became the father of Jesse;

2.zh: 耶西生长子以利押，次子亚比拿达，三子示米亚，
2.en: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,

2.zh: 四子拿坦业，五子拉代，
2.en: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

2.zh: 六子阿鲜，七子大卫。
2.en: Ozem the sixth, and David the seventh;

2.zh: 他们的姊妹是洗鲁雅和亚比该。洗鲁雅的儿子是亚比筛、约押、亚撒黑，共三人。
2.en: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.

2.zh: 亚比该生亚玛撒；亚玛撒的父亲是以实玛利人益帖。
2.en: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.

2.zh: 希斯 的儿子迦勒娶阿苏巴和耶略为妻，阿苏巴的儿子是耶设、朔罢、押墩。
2.en: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

2.zh: 阿苏巴死了，迦勒又娶以法她，生了户珥。
2.en: Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.

2.zh: 户珥生乌利；乌利生比撒列。
2.en: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.

2.zh: 希斯 正六十岁娶了基列父亲玛吉的女儿，与她同房；玛吉的女儿生了西割；
2.en: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.

2.zh: 西割生睚珥。睚珥在基列地有二十三个城邑。
2.en: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

2.zh: 后来基述人和亚兰人夺了睚珥的城邑，并基纳和其乡村，共六十个。这都是基列父亲玛吉之子的。
2.en: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

2.zh: 希斯 在迦勒·以法他死后，他的妻亚比雅给他生了亚施户；亚施户是提哥亚的父亲。
2.en: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron’s wife, bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

2.zh: 希斯 的长子耶拉篾生长子兰，又生布拿、阿连、阿鲜、亚希雅。
2.en: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.

2.zh: 耶拉篾又娶一妻名叫亚她拉，是阿南的母亲。
2.en: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.

2.zh: 耶拉篾长子兰的儿子是玛斯、雅悯、以结。
2.en: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

2.zh: 阿南的儿子是沙买、雅大。沙买的儿子是拿答、亚比述。
2.en: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

2.zh: 亚比述的妻名叫亚比孩，亚比孩给他生了亚办和摩利。
2.en: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban and Molid.

2.zh: 拿答的儿子是西列、亚遍；西列死了没有儿子。
2.en: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled died without children.

2.zh: 亚遍的儿子是以示；以示的儿子是示珊；示珊的儿子是亚来。
2.en: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.

2.zh: 沙买兄弟雅大的儿子是益帖、约拿单；益帖死了没有儿子。
2.en: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.

2.zh: 约拿单的儿子是比勒、撒萨。这都是耶拉篾的子孙。
2.en: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

2.zh: 示珊没有儿子，只有女儿。示珊有一个仆人名叫耶哈，是埃及人。
2.en: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

2.zh: 示珊将女儿给了仆人耶哈为妻，给他生了亚太。
2.en: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.

2.zh: 亚太生拿单；拿单生撒拔；
2.en: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,

2.zh: 撒拔生以弗拉；以弗拉生俄备得；
2.en: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,

2.zh: 俄备得生耶户；耶户生亚撒利雅；
2.en: and Obed became the father of Jehu, and Jehu became the father of Azariah,

2.zh: 亚撒利雅生希利斯；希利斯生以利亚萨；
2.en: and Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah,

2.zh: 以利亚萨生西斯买；西斯买生沙龙；
2.en: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai became the father of Shallum,

2.zh: 沙龙生耶加米雅；耶加米雅生以利沙玛。
2.en: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.

2.zh: 耶拉篾兄弟迦勒的长子米沙，是西弗之祖玛利沙的儿子，是希伯 之祖。
2.en: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

2.zh: 希伯 的儿子是可拉、他普亚、利肯、示玛。
2.en: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

2.zh: 示玛生拉含，是约干之祖。利肯生沙买。
2.en: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.

2.zh: 沙买的儿子是玛云；玛云是伯·夙之祖。
2.en: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.

2.zh: 迦勒的妾以法生哈兰、摩撒、迦谢；哈兰生迦卸。（
2.en: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.

2.zh: 雅代的儿子是利健、约坦、基珊、毗力、以法、沙亚弗。）
2.en: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

2.zh: 迦勒的妾玛迦生示别、特哈拿，
2.en: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.

2.zh: 又生麦玛拿之祖沙亚弗、抹比拿和基比亚之祖示法。迦勒的女儿是押撒。
2.en: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

2.zh: 迦勒的子孙就是以法她的长子、户珥的儿子，记在下面：基列·耶琳之祖朔巴，
2.en: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,

2.zh: 伯利恒之祖萨玛，伯迦得之祖哈勒。
2.en: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.

2.zh: 基列·耶琳之祖朔巴的子孙是哈罗以和一半米努·哈人。
2.en: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.

2.zh: 基列·耶琳的诸族是以帖人、布特人、舒玛人、密来人，又从这些族中生出琐拉人和以实陶人来。
2.en: The families of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.

2.zh: 萨玛的子孙是伯利恒人、尼陀法人、亚他绿·伯·约押人、一半玛拿哈人、琐利人，
2.en: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.

2.zh: 和住雅比斯众文士家的特拉人、示米押人、苏甲人。这都是基尼人利甲家之祖哈末所生的。
2.en: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.

3.zh: 大卫在希伯 所生的儿子记在下面：长子暗嫩是耶斯列人亚希暖生的。次子但以利是迦密人亚比该生的。
3.en: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;

3.zh: 三子押沙龙是基述王达买的女儿玛迦生的。四子亚多尼雅是哈及生的。
3.en: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;

3.zh: 五子示法提雅是亚比她生的。六子以特念是大卫的妻以格拉生的。
3.en: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:

3.zh: 这六人都是大卫在希伯 生的。大卫在希伯 作王七年零六个月，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。
3.en: six were born to him in Hebron; and he reigned there seven years and six months. He reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem;

3.zh: 大卫在耶路撒冷所生的儿子是示米亚、朔罢、拿单、所罗门。这四人是亚米利的女儿拔·书亚生的。
3.en: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;

3.zh: 还有益辖、以利沙玛、以利法列、
3.en: and Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,

3.zh: 挪迦、尼斐、雅非亚、
3.en: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

3.zh: 以利沙玛、以利雅大、以利法列，共九人。
3.en: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

3.zh: 这都是大卫的儿子，还有他们的妹子她玛，妃嫔的儿子不在其内。
3.en: All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.

3.zh: 所罗门的儿子是罗波安；罗波安的儿子是亚比雅；亚比雅的儿子是亚撒；亚撒的儿子是约沙法；
3.en: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

3.zh: 约沙法的儿子是约兰；约兰的儿子是亚哈谢；亚哈谢的儿子是约阿施；
3.en: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

3.zh: 约阿施的儿子是亚玛谢；亚玛谢的儿子是亚撒利雅；亚撒利雅的儿子是约坦；
3.en: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

3.zh: 约坦的儿子是亚哈斯；亚哈斯的儿子是希西家；希西家的儿子是玛拿西；
3.en: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

3.zh: 玛拿西的儿子是亚们；亚们的儿子是约西亚；
3.en: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.

3.zh: 约西亚的长子是约哈难，次子是约雅敬，三子是西底家，四子是沙龙。
3.en: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.

3.zh: 约雅敬的儿子是耶哥尼雅和西底家。
3.en: The sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah his son.

3.zh: 耶哥尼雅被掳。他的儿子是撒拉铁、
3.en: The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,

3.zh: 玛基兰、毗大雅、示拿萨、耶加米、何沙玛、尼大比雅。
3.en: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

3.zh: 毗大雅的儿子是所罗巴伯、示每。所罗巴伯的儿子是米书兰、哈拿尼雅，他们的妹子名叫示罗密。
3.en: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;

3.zh: 米书兰的儿子是哈舒巴、阿黑、比利家、哈撒底、于沙·希悉，共五人。
3.en: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed, five.

3.zh: 哈拿尼雅的儿子是毗拉提、耶筛亚。还有利法雅的众子，亚珥难的众子，俄巴底亚的众子，示迦尼的众子。
3.en: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.

3.zh: 示迦尼的儿子是示玛雅；示玛雅的儿子是哈突、以甲、巴利亚、尼利雅、沙法，共六人。
3.en: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

3.zh: 尼利雅的儿子是以利约乃、希西家、亚斯利干，共三人。
3.en: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.

3.zh: 以利约乃的儿子是何大雅、以利亚实、毗莱雅、阿谷、约哈难、第莱雅、阿拿尼，共七人。
3.en: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.

4.zh: 犹大的儿子是法勒斯、希斯 、迦米、户珥、朔巴。
4.en: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

4.zh: 朔巴的儿子利亚雅生雅哈；雅哈生亚户买和拉哈。这是琐拉人的诸族。
4.en: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

4.zh: 以坦之祖的儿子是耶斯列、伊施玛、伊得巴；他们的妹子名叫哈悉勒玻尼。
4.en: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.

4.zh: 基多之祖是毗努伊勒。户沙之祖是以谢珥。这都是伯利恒之祖以法她的长子户珥所生的。
4.en: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.

4.zh: 提哥亚之祖亚施户有两个妻子：一名希拉，一名拿拉。
4.en: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

4.zh: 拿拉给亚施户生亚户撒、希弗、提米尼、哈辖斯他利。这都是拿拉的儿子。
4.en: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

4.zh: 希拉的儿子是洗列、琐辖、伊提南。
4.en: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.

4.zh: 哥斯生亚诺、琐比巴，并哈 儿子亚哈黑的诸族。
4.en: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

4.zh: 雅比斯比他众弟兄更尊贵，他母亲给他起名叫雅比斯，意思说：我生他甚是痛苦。
4.en: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”

4.zh: 雅比斯求告以色列的　神说：「甚愿你赐福与我，扩张我的境界，常与我同在，保佑我不遭患难，不受艰苦。」　神就应允他所求的。
4.en: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!” God granted him that which he requested.

4.zh: 书哈的弟兄基绿生米黑，米黑是伊施屯之祖。
4.en: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

4.zh: 伊施屯生伯拉巴、巴西亚，并珥拿辖之祖提欣拿，这都是利迦人。
4.en: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.

4.zh: 基纳斯的儿子是俄陀聂、西莱雅。俄陀聂的儿子是哈塔。
4.en: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.

4.zh: 悯挪太生俄弗拉；西莱雅生革·夏纳欣人之祖约押。他们都是匠人。
4.en: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim, for they were craftsmen.

4.zh: 耶孚尼的儿子是迦勒；迦勒的儿子是以路、以拉、拿安。以拉的儿子是基纳斯。
4.en: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.

4.zh: 耶哈利勒的儿子是西弗、西法、提利、亚撒列。
4.en: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

4.zh: 以斯拉的儿子是益帖、米列、以弗、雅伦。米列娶法老女儿比提雅为妻，生米利暗、沙买，和以实提摩之祖益巴。米列又娶犹大女子为妻，生基多之祖雅列，梭哥之祖希伯，和撒挪亚之祖耶古铁。
4.en: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.

4.zh: 荷第雅的妻是拿含的妹子，她所生的儿子是迦米人基伊拉和玛迦人以实提摩之祖。
4.en: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

4.zh: 示门的儿子是暗嫩、林拿、便·哈南、提伦。 以示的儿子是梭黑与便·梭黑。
4.en: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.

4.zh: 犹大的儿子是示拉；示拉的儿子是利迦之祖珥，玛利沙之祖拉大，和属亚实比族织细麻布的各家。
4.en: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;

4.zh: 还有约敬、哥西巴人、约阿施、萨拉，就是在摩押地掌权的，又有雅叔比利恒。这都是古时所记载的。
4.en: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.

4.zh: 这些人都是窑匠，是尼他应和基低拉的居民；与王同处，为王做工。
4.en: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king for his work.

4.zh: 西缅的儿子是尼母利、雅悯、雅立、谢拉、扫罗。
4.en: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;

4.zh: 扫罗的儿子是沙龙；沙龙的儿子是米比衫；米比衫的儿子是米施玛；
4.en: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.

4.zh: 米施玛的儿子是哈母利；哈母利的儿子是撒刻；撒刻的儿子是示每。
4.en: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.

4.zh: 示每有十六个儿子，六个女儿，他弟兄的儿女不多，他们各家不如犹大族的人丁增多。
4.en: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn’t have many children, and all their family didn’t multiply like the children of Judah.

4.zh: 西缅人住在别是巴、摩拉大、哈萨·书亚、
4.en: They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,

4.zh: 辟拉、以森、陀腊、
4.en: at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,

4.zh: 彼土利、何珥玛、洗革拉、
4.en: at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,

4.zh: 伯·玛嘉博、哈萨·苏撒、伯·比利、沙拉音，这些城邑直到大卫作王的时候都是属西缅人的。
4.en: at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.

4.zh: 他们的五个城邑是以坦、亚因、临门、陀健、亚珊；
4.en: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;

4.zh: 还有属城的乡村，直到巴力。这是他们的住处，他们都有家谱。
4.en: and all their villages that were around the same cities, as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept their genealogy.

4.zh: 还有米所巴、雅米勒、亚玛谢的儿子约沙、
4.en: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,

4.zh: 约珥、约示比的儿子耶户；约示比是西莱雅的儿子；西莱雅是亚薛的儿子。
4.en: Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

4.zh: 还有以利约乃、雅哥巴、约朔海、亚帅雅、亚底业、耶西篾、比拿雅、
4.en: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,

4.zh: 示非的儿子细撒。示非是亚龙的儿子；亚龙是耶大雅的儿子；耶大雅是申利的儿子；申利是示玛雅的儿子。
4.en: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—

4.zh: 以上所记的人名都是作族长的，他们宗族的人数增多。
4.en: these mentioned by name were princes in their families. Their fathers’ houses increased greatly.

4.zh: 他们往平原东边基多口去，寻找牧放羊群的草场，
4.en: They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

4.zh: 寻得肥美的草场地，又宽阔又平静。从前住那里的是含族的人。
4.en: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful, for those who lived there before were descended from Ham.

4.zh: 以上录名的人，在犹大王希西家年间，来攻击含族人的帐棚和那里所有的米乌尼人，将他们灭尽，就住在他们的地方，直到今日，因为那里有草场可以牧放羊群。
4.en: These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents and the Meunim who were found there; and they destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.

4.zh: 这西缅人中，有五百人上西珥山，率领他们的是以示的儿子毗拉提、尼利雅、利法雅，和乌薛，
4.en: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

4.zh: 杀了逃脱剩下的亚玛力人，就住在那里直到今日。
4.en: They struck the remnant of the Amalekites who escaped, and have lived there to this day.

5.zh: 以色列的长子原是吕便；因他污秽了父亲的床，他长子的名分就归了约瑟。只是按家谱他不算长子。
5.en: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (for he was the firstborn, but because he defiled his father’s couch, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; and the genealogy is not to be listed according to the birthright.

5.zh: 犹大胜过一切弟兄，君王也是从他而出；长子的名分却归约瑟。
5.en: For Judah prevailed above his brothers, and from him came the prince; but the birthright was Joseph’s)—

5.zh: 以色列长子吕便的儿子是哈诺、法路、希斯伦、迦米。
5.en: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

5.zh: 约珥的儿子是示玛雅；示玛雅的儿子是歌革；歌革的儿子是示每；
5.en: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

5.zh: 示每的儿子是米迦；米迦的儿子是利亚雅；利亚雅的儿子是巴力；
5.en: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

5.zh: 巴力的儿子是备拉。这备拉作吕便支派的首领，被亚述王提革拉·毗列色掳去。
5.en: and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive. He was prince of the Reubenites.

5.zh: 他的弟兄照着宗族，按着家谱作族长的是耶利、撒迦利雅、比拉。
5.en: His brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was listed: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

5.zh: 比拉是亚撒的儿子；亚撒是示玛的儿子；示玛是约珥的儿子；约珥所住的地方是从亚罗珥直到尼波和巴力·免，
5.en: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon;

5.zh: 又向东延到幼发拉底河这边的旷野，因为他们在基列地牲畜增多。
5.en: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

5.zh: 扫罗年间，他们与夏甲人争战，夏甲人倒在他们手下，他们就在基列东边的全地，住在夏甲人的帐棚里。
5.en: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.

5.zh: 迦得的子孙在吕便对面，住在巴珊地，延到撒迦。
5.en: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah:

5.zh: 他们中间有作族长的约珥，有作副族长的沙番，还有雅乃和住在巴珊的沙法。
5.en: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

5.zh: 他们族弟兄是米迦勒、米书兰、示巴、约赖、雅干、细亚、希伯，共七人。
5.en: Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.

5.zh: 这都是亚比孩的儿子。亚比孩是户利的儿子；户利是耶罗亚的儿子；耶罗亚是基列的儿子；基列是米迦勒的儿子；米迦勒是耶示筛的儿子；耶示筛是耶哈多的儿子；耶哈多是布斯的儿子。
5.en: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

5.zh: 还有古尼的孙子、押比叠的儿子亚希。这都是作族长的。
5.en: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.

5.zh: 他们住在基列与巴珊和巴珊的乡村，并沙 的郊野，直到四围的交界。
5.en: They lived in Gilead in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon as far as their borders.

5.zh: 这些人在犹大王约坦并在以色列王耶罗波安年间，都载入家谱。
5.en: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

5.zh: 吕便人、迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人，能拿盾牌和刀剑、拉弓射箭、出征善战的勇士共有四万四千七百六十名。
5.en: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, able to shoot with bow, and skillful in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty that were able to go out to war.

5.zh: 他们与夏甲人、伊突人、拿非施人、挪答人争战。
5.en: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.

5.zh: 他们得了　[神的]帮助，夏甲人和跟随夏甲的人都交在他们手中；因为他们在阵上呼求　神，倚赖　神，　神就应允他们。
5.en: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all who were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he answered them because they put their trust in him.

5.zh: 他们掳掠了夏甲人的牲畜，有骆驼五万，羊二十五万，驴二千；又有人十万。
5.en: They took away their livestock: of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand, and of donkeys two thousand, and of men one hundred thousand.

5.zh: 敌人被杀仆倒的甚多，因为这争战是出乎　神。他们就住在敌人的地上，直到被掳的时候。
5.en: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity.

5.zh: 玛拿西半支派的人住在那地。从巴珊延到巴力·黑们、示尼珥与黑门山。
5.en: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.

5.zh: 他们的族长是以弗、以示、以列、亚斯列、耶利米、何达威雅、雅叠，都是大能的勇士，是有名的人，也是作族长的。
5.en: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.

5.zh: 他们得罪了他们列祖的　神，随从那地之民的神行邪淫；这民就是　神在他们面前所除灭的。
5.en: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them.

5.zh: 故此，以色列的　神激动亚述王普勒和亚述王提革拉·毗列色的心，他们就把吕便人、迦得人、玛拿西半支派的人掳到哈腊、哈博、哈拉与歌散河边，直到今日还在那里。
5.en: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried away the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.

6.zh: 利未的儿子是革顺、哥辖、米拉利。
6.en: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

6.zh: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦、乌薛。
6.en: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

6.zh: 暗兰的儿子是亚伦、摩西，还有女儿米利暗。亚伦的儿子是拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛。
6.en: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

6.zh: 以利亚撒生非尼哈；非尼哈生亚比书；
6.en: Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, Phinehas became the father of Abishua,

6.zh: 亚比书生布基；布基生乌西；
6.en: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.

6.zh: 乌西生西拉希雅；西拉希雅生米拉约；
6.en: Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth.

6.zh: 米拉约生亚玛利雅；亚玛利雅生亚希突；
6.en: Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

6.zh: 亚希突生撒督；撒督生亚希玛斯；
6.en: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz.

6.zh: 亚希玛斯生亚撒利雅；亚撒利雅生约哈难；
6.en: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.

6.zh: 约哈难生亚撒利雅（这亚撒利雅在所罗门于耶路撒冷所建造的殿中，供祭司的职分）；
6.en: Johanan became the father of Azariah, who executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.

6.zh: 亚撒利雅生亚玛利雅；亚玛利雅生亚希突；
6.en: Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

6.zh: 亚希突生撒督；撒督生沙龙；
6.en: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Shallum.

6.zh: 沙龙生希勒家；希勒家生亚撒利雅；
6.en: Shallum became the father of Hilkiah. Hilkiah became the father of Azariah.

6.zh: 亚撒利雅生西莱雅；西莱雅生约萨答。
6.en: Azariah became the father of Seraiah. Seraiah became the father of Jehozadak.

6.zh: 当耶和华借尼布甲尼撒的手掳掠犹大和耶路撒冷人的时候，这约萨答也被[掳去]。
6.en: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

6.zh: 利未的儿子是革顺、哥辖、米拉利。
6.en: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

6.zh: 革顺的儿子名叫立尼、示每。
6.en: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

6.zh: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦、乌薛。
6.en: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

6.zh: 米拉利的儿子是抹利、母示。这是按着利未人宗族分的各家。
6.en: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.

6.zh: 革顺的儿子是立尼；立尼的儿子是雅哈；雅哈的儿子是薪玛；
6.en: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

6.zh: 薪玛的儿子是约亚；约亚的儿子是易多；易多的儿子是谢拉；谢拉的儿子是耶特赖。
6.en: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.

6.zh: 哥辖的儿子是亚米拿达；亚米拿达的儿子是可拉；可拉的儿子是亚惜；
6.en: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

6.zh: 亚惜的儿子是以利加拿；以利加拿的儿子是以比雅撒；以比雅撒的儿子是亚惜；
6.en: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,

6.zh: 亚惜的儿子是他哈；他哈的儿子是乌列；乌列的儿子是乌西雅；乌西雅的儿子是少罗。
6.en: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

6.zh: 以利加拿的儿子是亚玛赛和亚希摩。
6.en: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.

6.zh: 亚希摩的儿子是以利加拿；以利加拿的儿子是琐菲；琐菲的儿子是拿哈；
6.en: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, Nahath his son,

6.zh: 拿哈的儿子是以利押；以利押的儿子是耶罗罕；耶罗罕的儿子是以利加拿；以利加拿的儿子是撒母耳。
6.en: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.

6.zh: 撒母耳的长子是约珥，次子是亚比亚。
6.en: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.

6.zh: 米拉利的儿子是抹利；抹利的儿子是立尼；立尼的儿子是示每；示每的儿子是乌撒；
6.en: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,

6.zh: 乌撒的儿子是示米亚；示米亚的儿子是哈基雅；哈基雅的儿子是亚帅雅。
6.en: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

6.zh: 约柜安设之后，大卫派人在耶和华殿中管理歌唱的事。
6.en: These are they whom David set over the service of song in the LORD’s house after the ark came to rest there.

6.zh: 他们就在会幕前当歌唱的差，及至所罗门在耶路撒冷建造了耶和华的殿，他们便按着班次供职。
6.en: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting until Solomon had built the LORD’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.

6.zh: 供职的人和他们的子孙记在下面： 哥辖的子孙中有歌唱的希幔。希幔是约珥的儿子；约珥是撒母耳的儿子；
6.en: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

6.zh: 撒母耳是以利加拿的儿子；以利加拿是耶罗罕的儿子；耶罗罕是以列的儿子；以列是陀亚的儿子；
6.en: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

6.zh: 陀亚是苏弗的儿子；苏弗是以利加拿的儿子；以利加拿是玛哈的儿子；玛哈是亚玛赛的儿子；
6.en: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

6.zh: 亚玛赛是以利加拿的儿子；以利加拿是约珥的儿子；约珥是亚撒利雅的儿子；亚撒利雅是西番雅的儿子；
6.en: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

6.zh: 西番雅是他哈的儿子；他哈是亚惜的儿子；亚惜是以比雅撒的儿子；以比雅撒是可拉的儿子；
6.en: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

6.zh: 可拉是以斯哈的儿子；以斯哈是哥辖的儿子；哥辖是利未的儿子；利未是以色列的儿子。
6.en: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

6.zh: 希幔的族兄亚萨是比利家的儿子，亚萨在希幔右边供职。比利家是示米亚的儿子；
6.en: His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,

6.zh: 示米亚是米迦勒的儿子；米迦勒是巴西雅的儿子；巴西雅是玛基雅的儿子；
6.en: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,

6.zh: 玛基雅是伊特尼的儿子；伊特尼是谢拉的儿子；谢拉是亚大雅的儿子；
6.en: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

6.zh: 亚大雅是以探的儿子；以探是薪玛的儿子；薪玛是示每的儿子；
6.en: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

6.zh: 示每是雅哈的儿子；雅哈是革顺的儿子。革顺是利未的儿子。
6.en: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

6.zh: 他们的族弟兄米拉利的子孙，在他们左边供职的有以探。以探是基示的儿子；基示是亚伯底的儿子；亚伯底是玛鹿的儿子；
6.en: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

6.zh: 玛鹿是哈沙比雅的儿子；哈沙比雅是亚玛谢的儿子；亚玛谢是希勒家的儿子；
6.en: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

6.zh: 希勒家是暗西的儿子；暗西是巴尼的儿子；巴尼是沙麦的儿子；
6.en: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,

6.zh: 沙麦是末力的儿子；末力是母示的儿子；母示是米拉利的儿子；米拉利是利未的儿子。
6.en: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

6.zh: 他们的族弟兄利未人也被派办　神殿中的一切事。
6.en: Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God’s house.

6.zh: 亚伦和他的子孙在燔祭坛和香坛上献祭烧香，又在至圣所办理一切的事，为以色列人赎罪，是照　神仆人摩西所吩咐的。
6.en: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

6.zh: 亚伦的儿子是以利亚撒；以利亚撒的儿子是非尼哈；非尼哈的儿子是亚比书；
6.en: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

6.zh: 亚比书的儿子是布基；布基的儿子是乌西；乌西的儿子是西拉希雅；
6.en: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

6.zh: 西拉希雅的儿子是米拉约；米拉约的儿子是亚玛利雅；亚玛利雅的儿子是亚希突；
6.en: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

6.zh: 亚希突的儿子是撒督；撒督的儿子是亚希玛斯。
6.en: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.

6.zh: 他们的住处按着境内的营寨，记在下面：哥辖族亚伦的子孙[先]拈阄得地，
6.en: Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),

6.zh: 在犹大地中得了希伯 和四围的郊野；
6.en: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands around it;

6.zh: 只是属城的田地和村庄都为耶孚尼的儿子迦勒所得。
6.en: but the fields of the city and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

6.zh: 亚伦的子孙得了逃城希伯 ，又得了立拿与其郊野，雅提珥、以实提莫与其郊野；
6.en: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron, Libnah also with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,

6.zh: 希 与其郊野，底璧与其郊野，
6.en: Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,

6.zh: 亚珊与其郊野，伯·示麦与其郊野。
6.en: Ashan with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands;

6.zh: 在便雅悯支派的地中，得了迦巴与其郊野，阿勒篾与其郊野，亚拿突与其郊野。他们诸家所得的城共十三座。
6.en: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its pasture lands, Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

6.zh: 哥辖族其余的人又拈阄，在玛拿西半支派的地中得了十座城。
6.en: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.

6.zh: 革顺族按着宗族，在以萨迦支派的地中，亚设支派的地中，拿弗他利支派的地中，巴珊内玛拿西支派的地中，得了十三座城。
6.en: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

6.zh: 米拉利族按着宗族拈阄，在吕便支派的地中，迦得支派的地中，西布伦支派的地中，得了十二座城。
6.en: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

6.zh: 以色列人将这些城与其郊野给了利未人。
6.en: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.

6.zh: 这以上录名的城，在犹大、西缅、便雅悯三支派的地中，以色列人拈阄给了他们。
6.en: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.

6.zh: 哥辖族中有几家在以法莲支派的地中也得了城邑，
6.en: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.

6.zh: 在以法莲山地得了逃城示剑与其郊野，又得了基色与其郊野，
6.en: They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands and Gezer with its pasture lands,

6.zh: 约缅与其郊野，伯·和 与其郊野，
6.en: Jokmeam with its pasture lands, Beth Horon with its pasture lands,

6.zh: 亚雅 与其郊野，迦特·临门与其郊野。
6.en: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands;

6.zh: 哥辖族其余的人在玛拿西半支派的地中得了亚乃与其郊野，比连与其郊野。
6.en: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its pasture lands, and Bileam with its pasture lands, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.

6.zh: 革顺族在玛拿西半支派的地中得了巴珊的哥兰与其郊野，亚斯他录与其郊野；
6.en: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, and Ashtaroth with its pasture lands;

6.zh: 又在以萨迦支派的地中得了基低斯与其郊野，大比拉与其郊野，
6.en: and out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,

6.zh: 拉末与其郊野，亚年与其郊野；
6.en: Ramoth with its pasture lands, and Anem with its pasture lands;

6.zh: 在亚设支派的地中得了玛沙与其郊野，押顿与其郊野，
6.en: and out of the tribe of Asher, Mashal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,

6.zh: 户割与其郊野，利合与其郊野；
6.en: Hukok with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands;

6.zh: 在拿弗他利支派的地中得了加利利的基低斯与其郊野，哈们与其郊野，基列亭与其郊野。
6.en: and out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, Hammon with its pasture lands, and Kiriathaim with its pasture lands.

6.zh: 还有米拉利族的人在西布伦支派的地中得了临摩挪与其郊野，他泊与其郊野；
6.en: To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its pasture lands, and Tabor with its pasture lands;

6.zh: 又在耶利哥的约旦河东，在吕便支派的地中得了旷野的比悉与其郊野，雅哈撒与其郊野，
6.en: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasture lands, Jahzah with its pasture lands,

6.zh: 基底莫与其郊野，米法押与其郊野；
6.en: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands;

6.zh: 又在迦得支派的地中得了基列的拉末与其郊野，玛哈念与其郊野，
6.en: and out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, Mahanaim with its pasture lands,

6.zh: 希实本与其郊野，雅谢与其郊野。
6.en: Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands.

7.zh: 以萨迦的儿子是陀拉、普瓦、雅述、伸 ，共四人。
7.en: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

7.zh: 陀拉的儿子是乌西、利法雅、耶勒、雅买、易伯散、示母利，都是陀拉的族长，是大能的勇士。到大卫年间，他们的人数共有二万二千六百名。
7.en: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.

7.zh: 乌西的儿子是伊斯拉希；伊斯拉希的儿子是米迦勒、俄巴底亚、约珥、伊示雅，共五人，都是族长。
7.en: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.

7.zh: 他们所率领的，按着宗族出战的军队，共有三万六千人，因为他们的妻和子众多。
7.en: With them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the army for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.

7.zh: 他们的族弟兄在以萨迦各族中都是大能的勇士，按着家谱计算共有八万七千人。
7.en: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, listed in all by genealogy, were eighty-seven thousand.

7.zh: 便雅悯[的儿子]是比拉、比结、耶叠，共三人。
7.en: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.

7.zh: 比拉的儿子是以斯本、乌西、乌薛、耶利摩、以利，共五人，都是族长，是大能的勇士。按着家谱计算，他们的子孙共有二万二千零三十四人。
7.en: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were listed by genealogy twenty-two thousand thirty-four.

7.zh: 比结的儿子是细米拉、约阿施、以利以谢、以利约乃、暗利、耶利摩、亚比雅、亚拿突、亚拉篾。这都是比结的儿子。
7.en: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.

7.zh: 他们都是族长，是大能的勇士。按着家谱计算，他们的子孙共有二万零二百人。
7.en: They were listed by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand two hundred.

7.zh: 耶叠的儿子是比勒罕；比勒罕的儿子是耶乌施、便雅悯、以忽、基拿拿、细坦、他施、亚希沙哈。
7.en: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

7.zh: 这都是耶叠的儿子，都是族长，是大能的勇士；他们的子孙能上阵打仗的，共有一万七千二百人。
7.en: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.

7.zh: 还有以珥的儿子书品、户品，并亚黑的儿子户伸。
7.en: So were Shuppim, Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, and the sons of Aher.

7.zh: 拿弗他利的儿子是雅薛、沽尼、耶色、沙龙。这都是辟拉的子孙。
7.en: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.

7.zh: 玛拿西的儿子亚斯列是他妾亚兰人所生的，又生了基列之父玛吉。
7.en: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore. She bore Machir the father of Gilead.

7.zh: 玛吉娶的妻是户品、书品的妹子，名叫玛迦。玛拿西的次子名叫西罗非哈；西罗非哈但有几个女儿。
7.en: Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah. The name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.

7.zh: 玛吉的妻玛迦生了一个儿子，起名叫毗利施。毗利施的兄弟名叫示利施；示利施的儿子是乌兰和利金。
7.en: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh. The name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

7.zh: 乌兰的儿子是比但。这都是基列的子孙。基列是玛吉的儿子，玛吉是玛拿西的儿子。
7.en: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

7.zh: 基列的妹子哈摩利吉生了伊施荷、亚比以谢、玛拉。（
7.en: His sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.

7.zh: 示米大的儿子是亚现、示剑、利克希、阿尼安。）
7.en: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.

7.zh: 以法莲的儿子是书提拉；书提拉的儿子是比列；比列的儿子是他哈；他哈的儿子是以拉大；以拉大的儿子是他哈；
7.en: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,

7.zh: 他哈的儿子是撒拔；撒拔的儿子是书提拉。以法莲又生以谢、以列；这二人因为下去夺取迦特人的牲畜，被本地的迦特人杀了。
7.en: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take away their livestock.

7.zh: 他们的父亲以法莲为他们悲哀了多日，他的弟兄都来安慰他。
7.en: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.

7.zh: 以法莲与妻同房，他妻就怀孕生了一子，以法莲因为家里遭祸，就给这儿子起名叫比利亚。
7.en: He went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because there was trouble with his house.

7.zh: 他的女儿名叫舍伊拉，就是建筑上伯·和 、下伯·和 与乌羡·舍伊拉的。
7.en: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.

7.zh: 比利阿的儿子是利法和利悉。利悉的儿子是他拉；他拉的儿子是他罕；
7.en: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,

7.zh: 他罕的儿子是拉但；拉但的儿子是亚米忽；亚米忽的儿子是以利沙玛；
7.en: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

7.zh: 以利沙玛的儿子是嫩；嫩的儿子是约书亚。
7.en: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.

7.zh: 以法莲人的地业和住处是伯特利与其村庄；东边拿兰，西边基色与其村庄；示剑与其村庄，直到迦萨与其村庄；
7.en: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;

7.zh: 还有靠近玛拿西人的境界，伯·善与其村庄；他纳与其村庄；米吉多与其村庄；多珥与其村庄。以色列儿子约瑟的子孙住在这些地方。
7.en: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.

7.zh: 亚设的儿子是音拿、亦施瓦、亦施韦、比利亚，还有他们的妹子西 拉。
7.en: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Serah was their sister.

7.zh: 比利亚的儿子是希别、玛结；玛结是比撒威的父亲。
7.en: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

7.zh: 希别生雅弗勒、朔默、何坦，和他们的妹子书雅。
7.en: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.

7.zh: 雅弗勒的儿子是巴萨、宾哈、亚施法。这都是雅弗勒的儿子。
7.en: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

7.zh: 朔默的儿子是亚希、罗迦、耶户巴、亚兰。
7.en: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

7.zh: 朔默兄弟希连的儿子是琐法、音那、示利斯、亚抹。
7.en: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.

7.zh: 琐法的儿子是书亚、哈尼弗、书阿勒、比利、音拉、
7.en: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,

7.zh: 比悉、河得、珊玛、施沙、益兰、比拉。
7.en: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.

7.zh: 益帖的儿子是耶孚尼、毗斯巴、亚拉。
7.en: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.

7.zh: 乌拉的儿子是亚拉、汉尼业、利写。
7.en: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.

7.zh: 这都是亚设的子孙，都是族长，是精壮大能的勇士，也是首领中的头目，按着家谱计算，他们的子孙能出战的共有二万六千人。
7.en: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.

8.zh: 便雅悯的长子比拉，次子亚实别，三子亚哈拉，
8.en: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,

8.zh: 四子挪哈，五子拉法。
8.en: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

8.zh: 比拉的儿子是亚大、基拉、亚比忽、
8.en: Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,

8.zh: 亚比书、乃幔、亚何亚、
8.en: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,

8.zh: 基拉、示孚汛、户兰。
8.en: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.

8.zh: 以忽的儿子作迦巴居民的族长，被掳到玛拿辖；
8.en: These are the sons of Ehud. These are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried captive to Manahath:

8.zh: 以忽的儿子乃幔、亚希亚、基拉也被掳去。基拉生乌撒、亚希忽。
8.en: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

8.zh: 沙哈连休他二妻户伸和巴拉之后，在摩押地生了儿子。
8.en: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.

8.zh: 他与妻贺得同房，生了约巴、洗比雅、米沙、玛拉干、
8.en: By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,

8.zh: 耶乌斯、沙迦、米玛。他这些儿子都是族长。
8.en: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.

8.zh: 他的妻户伸给他生的儿子有亚比突、以利巴力。
8.en: By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.

8.zh: 以利巴力的儿子是希伯、米珊、沙麦。沙麦建立阿挪和罗德二城与其村庄。
8.en: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;

8.zh: 又有比利亚和示玛是亚雅 居民的族长，是驱逐迦特人的。
8.en: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;

8.zh: 亚希约、沙煞、耶利末、
8.en: and Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,

8.zh: 西巴第雅、亚拉得、亚得、
8.en: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,

8.zh: 米迦勒、伊施巴、约哈都是比利亚的儿子。
8.en: Michael, Ishpah, Joha, the sons of Beriah,

8.zh: 西巴第雅、米书兰、希西基、希伯、
8.en: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,

8.zh: 伊施米莱、伊斯利亚、约巴都是以利巴力的儿子。
8.en: Ishmerai, Izliah, Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,

8.zh: 雅金、细基 利、撒底、
8.en: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,

8.zh: 以利乃、洗勒太、以列、
8.en: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,

8.zh: 亚大雅、比拉雅、申拉都是示每的儿子。
8.en: Adaiah, Beraiah, Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,

8.zh: 伊施班、希伯、以列、
8.en: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,

8.zh: 亚伯顿、细基利、哈难、
8.en: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,

8.zh: 哈拿尼雅、以拦、安陀提雅、
8.en: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,

8.zh: 伊弗底雅、毗努伊勒都是沙煞的儿子。
8.en: Iphdeiah, Penuel, the sons of Shashak,

8.zh: 珊示莱、示哈利、亚他利雅、
8.en: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,

8.zh: 雅利西、以利亚、细基利都是耶罗罕的儿子。
8.en: Jaareshiah, Elijah, Zichri, and the sons of Jeroham.

8.zh: 这些人都是著名的族长，住在耶路撒冷。
8.en: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.

8.zh: 在基遍住的有基遍的父亲耶利。他的妻名叫玛迦；
8.en: The father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon

8.zh: 他长子是亚伯顿。他又生苏珥、基士、巴力、拿答、
8.en: with his firstborn son Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,

8.zh: 基多、亚希约、撒迦、米基罗。
8.en: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,

8.zh: 米基罗生示米暗。这些人和他们的弟兄在耶路撒冷对面居住。
8.en: and Mikloth, who became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their families in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

8.zh: 尼珥生基士；基士生扫罗；扫罗生约拿单、麦基舒亚、亚比拿达、伊施·巴力。
8.en: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

8.zh: 约拿单的儿子是米力·巴力；米力·巴力生米迦。
8.en: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

8.zh: 米迦的儿子是毗敦、米勒、他利亚、亚哈斯；
8.en: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

8.zh: 亚哈斯生耶何阿达；耶何阿达生亚拉篾、亚斯玛威、心利；心利生摩撒；
8.en: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

8.zh: 摩撒生比尼亚；比尼亚的儿子是拉法；拉法的儿子是以利亚萨；以利亚萨的儿子是亚悉。
8.en: Moza became the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

8.zh: 亚悉有六个儿子，他们的名字是亚斯利干、波基路、以实玛利、示亚利雅、俄巴底雅、哈难。这都是亚悉的儿子。
8.en: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

8.zh: 亚悉兄弟以设的长子是乌兰，次子耶乌施，三子是以利法列。
8.en: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

8.zh: 乌兰的儿子都是大能的勇士，是弓箭手，他们有许多的子孙，共一百五十名，都是便雅悯人。
8.en: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and grandsons, one hundred fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.

9.zh: 以色列人都按家谱计算，写在以色列诸王记上。犹大人因犯罪就被掳到巴比伦。
9.en: So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.

9.zh: 先从巴比伦回来，住在自己地业城邑中的有以色列人、祭司、利未人、尼提宁[的首领]。
9.en: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.

9.zh: 住在耶路撒冷的有犹大人、便雅悯人、以法莲人、玛拿西人。
9.en: In Jerusalem, there lived of the children of Judah, of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:

9.zh: 犹大儿子法勒斯的子孙中有乌太。乌太是亚米忽的儿子；亚米忽是暗利的儿子；暗利是音利的儿子；音利是巴尼的儿子。
9.en: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.

9.zh: 示罗的子孙中有长子亚帅雅和他的众子。
9.en: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

9.zh: 谢拉的子孙中有耶乌利和他的弟兄，共六百九十人。
9.en: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.

9.zh: 便雅悯人中有哈西努的曾孙、何达威雅的孙子、米书兰的儿子撒路，
9.en: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;

9.zh: 又有耶罗罕的儿子伊比尼雅，米基立的孙子、乌西的儿子以拉，伊比尼雅的曾孙、流珥的孙子、示法提雅的儿子米书兰，
9.en: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

9.zh: 和他们的族弟兄，按着家谱[计算]共有九百五十六名。这些人都是他们的族长。
9.en: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers’ households by their fathers’ houses.

9.zh: 祭司中有耶大雅、耶何雅立、雅斤，
9.en: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,

9.zh: 还有管理　神殿希勒家的儿子亚萨利雅。希勒家是米书兰的儿子；米书兰是撒督的儿子；撒督是米拉约的儿子；米拉约是亚希突的儿子。
9.en: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house;

9.zh: 有玛基雅的曾孙、巴施户珥的孙子、耶罗罕的儿子亚大雅，又有亚第业的儿子玛赛；亚第业是雅希细拉的儿子；雅希细拉是米书兰的儿子；米书兰是米实利密的儿子；米实利密是音麦的儿子。
9.en: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

9.zh: 他们和众弟兄都是族长，共有一千七百六十人，是善于做　神殿使用之工的。
9.en: and their brothers, heads of their fathers’ houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty; they were very able men for the work of the service of God’s house.

9.zh: 利未人米拉利的子孙中，有哈沙比雅的曾孙、押利甘的孙子、哈述的儿子示玛雅。
9.en: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

9.zh: 有拔巴甲、黑勒施、迦拉，并亚萨的曾孙、细基利的孙子、米迦的儿子玛探雅，
9.en: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,

9.zh: 又有耶杜顿的曾孙、迦拉的孙子、示玛雅的儿子俄巴底，还有以利加拿的孙子、亚撒的儿子比利家。他们都住在尼陀法人的村庄。
9.en: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

9.zh: 守门的是沙龙、亚谷、达们、亚希幔，和他们的弟兄；沙龙为长。
9.en: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),

9.zh: 从前这些人看守朝东的王门，如今是利未营中守门的。
9.en: who previously served in the king’s gate eastward. They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.

9.zh: 可拉的曾孙、以比雅撒的孙子、可利的儿子沙龙，和他的族弟兄可拉人都管理使用之工，并守会幕的门。他们的祖宗曾管理耶和华的营盘，又把守营门。
9.en: Shallum was the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over the LORD’s camp, keepers of the entry.

9.zh: 从前以利亚撒的儿子非尼哈管理他们，耶和华也与他同在。
9.en: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him.

9.zh: 米施利米雅的儿子撒迦利雅是看守会幕之门的。
9.en: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.

9.zh: 被选守门的人共有二百一十二名。他们在自己的村庄，按着家谱计算，是大卫和先见撒母耳所派当这紧要职任的。
9.en: All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve. These were listed by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.

9.zh: 他们和他们的子孙按着班次看守耶和华殿的门，就是会幕的门。
9.en: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the LORD’s house, even the house of the tent, as guards.

9.zh: 在东西南北，四方都有守门的。
9.en: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.

9.zh: 他们的族弟兄住在村庄，每七日来与他们换班。
9.en: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them,

9.zh: 这四个门领都是利未人，各有紧要的职任，看守　神殿的仓库。
9.en: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.

9.zh: 他们住在　神殿的四围，是因委托他们守殿，要每日早晨开门。
9.en: They stayed around God’s house, because that was their duty; and it was their duty to open it morning by morning.

9.zh: 利未人中有管理使用器皿的，按着数目拿出拿入；
9.en: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service, for these were brought in by count, and these were taken out by count.

9.zh: 又有人管理器具和圣所的器皿，并细面、酒、油、乳香、香料。
9.en: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.

9.zh: 祭司中有人用香料做膏油。
9.en: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the spices.

9.zh: 利未人玛他提雅是可拉族沙龙的长子，他紧要的职任是管理盘中烤的物。
9.en: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.

9.zh: 他们族弟兄哥辖子孙中，有管理陈设饼的，每安息日预备摆列。
9.en: Some of their brothers, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath.

9.zh: 歌唱的有利未人的族长，住在[属殿的]房屋，昼夜供职，不做别样的工。
9.en: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service, for they were employed in their work day and night.

9.zh: 以上都是利未人著名的族长，住在耶路撒冷。
9.en: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men. They lived at Jerusalem.

9.zh: 在基遍住的有基遍的父亲耶利。他的妻名叫玛迦；
9.en: Jeiel the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon.

9.zh: 他长子是亚伯顿。他又生苏珥、基士、巴力、尼珥、拿答、
9.en: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

9.zh: 基多、亚希约、撒迦利雅、米基罗。
9.en: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.

9.zh: 米基罗生示米暗。这些人和他们的弟兄在耶路撒冷对面居住。
9.en: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

9.zh: 尼珥生基士；基士生扫罗；扫罗生约拿单、麦基舒亚、亚比拿达、伊施·巴力。
9.en: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

9.zh: 约拿单的儿子是米力·巴力；米力·巴力生米迦。
9.en: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

9.zh: 米迦的儿子是毗敦、米勒、他利亚、亚哈斯。
9.en: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.

9.zh: 亚哈斯生雅拉；雅拉生亚拉篾、亚斯玛威、心利；心利生摩撒；
9.en: Ahaz became the father of Jarah. Jarah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

9.zh: 摩撒生比尼亚；比尼亚生利法雅；利法雅的儿子是以利亚萨；以利亚萨的儿子是亚悉。
9.en: Moza became the father of Binea, Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

9.zh: 亚悉有六个儿子，他们的名字是亚斯利干、波基路、以实玛利、示亚利雅、俄巴底雅、哈难。这都是亚悉的儿子。
9.en: Azel had six sons, whose names are Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.

10.zh: 非利士人与以色列人争战，以色列人在非利士人面前逃跑，在基利波山有被杀仆倒的。
10.en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

10.zh: 非利士人紧追扫罗和他儿子们，就杀了扫罗的儿子约拿单、亚比拿达、麦基舒亚。
10.en: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

10.zh: 势派甚大，扫罗被弓箭手追上，射伤甚重，
10.en: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.

10.zh: 就吩咐拿他兵器的人说：「你拔出刀来，将我刺死，免得那些未受割礼的人来凌辱我。」但拿兵器的人甚惧怕，不肯刺他；
10.en: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.

10.zh: 扫罗就自己伏在刀上死了。拿兵器的人见扫罗已死，也伏在刀上死了。
10.en: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.

10.zh: 这样，扫罗和他三个儿子，并他的全家都一同死亡。
10.en: So Saul died with his three sons; and all his house died together.

10.zh: 住平原的以色列众人见以色列军兵逃跑，扫罗和他儿子都死了，也就弃城逃跑，非利士人便来住在其中。
10.en: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

10.zh: 次日，非利士人来剥那被杀之人的衣服，看见扫罗和他儿子仆倒在基利波山，
10.en: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

10.zh: 就剥了他的军装，割下他的首级，打发人到非利士地的四境报信与他们的偶像和众民，
10.en: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, then sent into the land of the Philistines all around to carry the news to their idols and to the people.

10.zh: 又将扫罗的军装放在他们神的庙里，将他的首级钉在大衮庙中。
10.en: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.

10.zh: 基列·雅比人听见非利士人向扫罗所行的一切事，
10.en: When all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

10.zh: 他们中间所有的勇士就起身前去，将扫罗和他儿子的尸身送到雅比，将他们的尸骨葬在雅比的橡树下，就禁食七日。
10.en: all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

10.zh: 这样，扫罗死了。因为他干犯耶和华，没有遵守耶和华的命；又因他求问交鬼的妇人，
10.en: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against the LORD, because of the LORD’s word, which he didn’t keep, and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit, to inquire,

10.zh: 没有求问耶和华，所以耶和华使他被杀，把国归于耶西的儿子大卫。
10.en: and didn’t inquire of the LORD. Therefore he killed him, and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.

11.zh: 以色列众人聚集到希伯 见大卫，说：「我们原是你的骨肉。
11.en: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

11.zh: 从前扫罗作王的时候，率领以色列人出入的是你；耶和华—你的　神也曾应许你说：『你必牧养我的民以色列，作以色列的君。』」
11.en: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. The LORD your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’”

11.zh: 于是以色列的长老都来到希伯 见大卫王。大卫在希伯 耶和华面前与他们立约，他们就膏大卫作以色列的王，是照耶和华借撒母耳所说的话。
11.en: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD. They anointed David king over Israel, according to the LORD’s word by Samuel.

11.zh: 大卫和以色列众人到了耶路撒冷，就是耶布斯；那时耶布斯人住在那里。
11.en: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.

11.zh: 耶布斯人对大卫说：「你决不能进这地方。」然而大卫攻取锡安的保障，就是大卫的城。
11.en: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here!” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.

11.zh: 大卫说：「谁先攻打耶布斯人，必作首领元帅。」洗鲁雅的儿子约押先上去，就作了元帅。
11.en: David had said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.

11.zh: 大卫住在保障里，所以那保障叫作大卫城。
11.en: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it David’s city.

11.zh: 大卫又从米罗起，四围建筑城墙，其余的是约押修理。
11.en: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

11.zh: 大卫日见强盛，因为万军之耶和华与他同在。
11.en: David grew greater and greater, for the LORD of Armies was with him.

11.zh: 以下记录跟随大卫勇士的首领，就是奋勇帮助他得国、照着耶和华吩咐以色列人的话、与以色列人一同立他作王的。
11.en: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to the LORD’s word concerning Israel.

11.zh: 大卫勇士的数目记在下面：哈革摩尼的儿子雅朔班，他是军长的统领，一时举枪杀了三百人。
11.en: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.

11.zh: 其次是亚合人朵多的儿子以利亚撒，他是三个勇士里的一个。
11.en: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.

11.zh: 他从前与大卫在巴斯·达闵，非利士人聚集要打仗。那里有一块长满大麦的田，众民就在非利士人面前逃跑；
11.en: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

11.zh: 这勇士便站在那田间击杀非利士人，救护了那田。耶和华使以色列人大获全胜。
11.en: They stood in the middle of the plot, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great victory.

11.zh: 三十个勇士中的三个人下到磐石那里，进了亚杜兰洞见大卫；非利士的军队在利乏音谷安营。
11.en: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

11.zh: 那时大卫在山寨，非利士人的防营在伯利恒。
11.en: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time.

11.zh: 大卫渴想，说：「甚愿有人将伯利恒城门旁井里的水打来给我喝！」
11.en: David longed, and said, “Oh, that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”

11.zh: 这三个勇士就闯过非利士人的营盘，从伯利恒城门旁的井里打水，拿来奉给大卫。他却不肯喝，将水奠在耶和华面前，
11.en: The three broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, took it, and brought it to David; but David would not drink any of it, but poured it out to the LORD,

11.zh: 说：「我的　神啊，这三个人冒死去打水，这水好像他们的血一般，我断不敢喝！」如此，大卫不肯喝。这是三个勇士所做的事。
11.en: and said, “My God forbid me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy?” For they risked their lives to bring it. Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.

11.zh: 约押的兄弟亚比筛是这三个勇士的首领；他举枪杀了三百人，就在三个勇士里得了名。
11.en: Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.

11.zh: 他在这三个勇士里是最尊贵的，所以作他们的首领；只是不及前三个勇士。
11.en: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain; however he wasn’t included in the three.

11.zh: 有甲薛勇士耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅行过大能的事：他杀了摩押人亚利伊勒的两个[儿子]，又在下雪的时候下坑里去杀了一个狮子，
11.en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.

11.zh: 又杀了一个埃及人。埃及人身高五肘，手里拿着枪，枪杆粗如织布的机轴；比拿雅只拿着棍子下去，从埃及人手里夺过枪来，用那枪将他刺死。
11.en: He killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high. In the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.

11.zh: 这是耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅所行的事，就在三个勇士里得了名。
11.en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things and had a name among the three mighty men.

11.zh: 他比那三十个勇士都尊贵，只是不及前三个勇士。大卫立他作护卫长。
11.en: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three; and David set him over his guard.

11.zh: 军中的勇士有约押的兄弟亚撒黑，伯利恒人朵多的儿子伊勒哈难，
11.en: The mighty men of the armies also include Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

11.zh: 哈律人沙玛，比伦人希利斯，
11.en: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

11.zh: 提哥亚人益吉的儿子以拉，亚拿突人亚比以谢，
11.en: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,

11.zh: 户沙人西比该，亚合人以来，
11.en: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

11.zh: 尼陀法人玛哈莱，尼陀法人巴拿的儿子希立，
11.en: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

11.zh: 便雅悯族基比亚人利拜的儿子以太，比拉顿人比拿雅，
11.en: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

11.zh: 迦实溪人户莱，亚拉巴人亚比，
11.en: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

11.zh: 巴路米人押斯玛弗，沙本人以利雅哈巴，
11.en: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

11.zh: 基孙人哈深的众子，哈拉人沙基的儿子约拿单，
11.en: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,

11.zh: 哈拉人沙甲的儿子亚希暗，吾珥的儿子以利法勒，
11.en: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

11.zh: 米基拉人希弗，比伦人亚希雅，
11.en: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

11.zh: 迦密人希斯罗，伊斯拜的儿子拿莱，
11.en: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

11.zh: 拿单的兄弟约珥，哈基利的儿子弥伯哈，
11.en: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,

11.zh: 亚扪人洗勒，比录人拿哈莱（拿哈莱是给洗鲁雅的儿子约押拿兵器的），
11.en: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite (the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah),

11.zh: 以帖人以拉，以帖人迦立，
11.en: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

11.zh: 赫人乌利亚，亚莱的儿子撒拔，
11.en: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

11.zh: 吕便人示撒的儿子亚第拿（他是吕便支派中的一个族长，率领三十人），
11.en: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite (a chief of the Reubenites), and thirty with him,

11.zh: 玛迦的儿子哈难，弥特尼人约沙法，
11.en: Hanan the son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,

11.zh: 亚施他拉人乌西亚，亚罗珥人何坦的儿子沙玛、耶利，
11.en: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,

11.zh: 提洗人申利的儿子耶叠和他的兄弟约哈，
11.en: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

11.zh: 玛哈未人以利业，伊利拿安的儿子耶利拜、约沙未雅，摩押人伊特玛、
11.en: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

11.zh: 以利业、俄备得，并米琐八人雅西业。
11.en: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

12.zh: 大卫因怕基士的儿子扫罗，躲在洗革拉的时候，有勇士到他那里帮助他打仗。
12.en: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish. They were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.

12.zh: 他们善于拉弓，能用左右两手甩石射箭，都是便雅悯人扫罗的族弟兄。
12.en: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow. They were of Saul’s relatives of the tribe of Benjamin.

12.zh: 为首的是亚希以谢，其次是约阿施，都是基比亚人示玛的儿子。还有亚斯玛威的儿子耶薛和毗力，又有比拉迦，并亚拿突人耶户，
12.en: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;

12.zh: 基遍人以实买雅（他在三十人中是勇士，管理他们），且有耶利米、雅哈悉、约哈难，和基得拉人约撒拔、
12.en: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty and a leader of the thirty; Jeremiah; Jahaziel; Johanan; Jozabad the Gederathite;

12.zh: 伊利乌赛、耶利摩、比亚利雅、示玛利雅，哈律弗人示法提雅，
12.en: Eluzai; Jerimoth; Bealiah; Shemariah; Shephatiah the Haruphite;

12.zh: 可拉人以利加拿、耶西亚、亚萨列、约以谢、雅朔班，
12.en: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;

12.zh: 基多人耶罗罕的儿子犹拉和西巴第雅。
12.en: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

12.zh: 迦得支派中有人到旷野的山寨投奔大卫，都是大能的勇士，能拿盾牌和枪的战士。他们的面貌好像狮子，快跑如同山上的鹿。
12.en: Some Gadites joined David in the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for war, who could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains:

12.zh: 第一以薛，第二俄巴底雅，第三以利押，
12.en: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

12.zh: 第四弥施玛拿，第五耶利米，
12.en: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

12.zh: 第六亚太，第七以利业，
12.en: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

12.zh: 第八约哈难，第九以利萨巴，
12.en: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

12.zh: 第十耶利米，第十一末巴奈。
12.en: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai the eleventh.

12.zh: 这都是迦得人中的军长，至小的能抵一百人，至大的能抵一千人。
12.en: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the army. He who was least was equal to one hundred, and the greatest to one thousand.

12.zh: 正月，约旦河水涨过两岸的时候，他们过河，使一切住平原的人东奔西逃。
12.en: These are those who went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all who lived in the valleys, both toward the east and toward the west.

12.zh: 又有便雅悯和犹大人到山寨大卫那里。
12.en: Some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.

12.zh: 大卫出去迎接他们，对他们说：「你们若是和和平平地来帮助我，我心就与你们相契；你们若是将我这无罪的人卖在敌人手里，愿我们列祖的　神察看责罚。」
12.en: David went out to meet them, and answered them, “If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it.”

12.zh: 那时　[神]的灵感动那三十个勇士的首领亚玛撒，[他就说]： 大卫啊，我们是归于你的！ 耶西的儿子啊，我们是帮助你的！ 愿你平平安安， 愿帮助你的也都平安！ 因为你的　神帮助你。 大卫就收留他们，立他们作军长。
12.en: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse. Peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you.” Then David received them and made them captains of the band.

12.zh: 大卫从前与非利士人同去，要与扫罗争战，有些玛拿西人来投奔大卫，他们却没有帮助非利士人；因为非利士人的首领商议，打发他们回去，说：「恐怕大卫拿我们的首级，归降他的主人扫罗。」
12.en: Some of Manasseh also joined David when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle, but they didn’t help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.”

12.zh: 大卫往洗革拉去的时候，有玛拿西人的千夫长押拿、约撒拔、耶叠、米迦勒、约撒拔、以利户、洗勒太都来投奔他。
12.en: As he went to Ziklag, some from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.

12.zh: 这些人帮助大卫攻击群贼；他们都是大能的勇士，且作军长。
12.en: They helped David against the band of raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and were captains in the army.

12.zh: 那时天天有人来帮助大卫，以致成了大军，如　神的军一样。
12.en: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like God’s army.

12.zh: 预备打仗的兵来到希伯 见大卫，要照着耶和华的话将扫罗的国位归与大卫。他们的数目如下：
12.en: These are the numbers of the heads of those who were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the LORD’s word.

12.zh: 犹大支派，拿盾牌和枪预备打仗的有六千八百人。
12.en: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, armed for war.

12.zh: 西缅支派，能上阵大能的勇士有七千一百人。
12.en: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valor for the war: seven thousand one hundred.

12.zh: 利未支派有四千六百人。
12.en: Of the children of Levi: four thousand six hundred.

12.zh: 耶何耶大是亚伦[家]的首领，跟从他的有三千七百人。
12.en: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron; and with him were three thousand seven hundred,

12.zh: 还有少年大能的勇士撒督，同着他的有族长二十二人。
12.en: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father’s house twenty-two captains.

12.zh: 便雅悯支派，扫罗的族弟兄也有三千人，他们向来大半归顺扫罗家。
12.en: Of the children of Benjamin, Saul’s relatives: three thousand, for until then, the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to Saul’s house.

12.zh: 以法莲支派大能的勇士，在本族著名的有二万零八百人。
12.en: Of the children of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers’ houses.

12.zh: 玛拿西半支派，册上有名的共一万八千人，都来立大卫作王。
12.en: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.

12.zh: 以萨迦支派，有二百族长都通达时务，知道以色列人所当行的；他们族弟兄都听从他们的命令。
12.en: Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were two hundred; and all their brothers were at their command.

12.zh: 西布伦支派，能上阵用各样兵器打仗、行伍整齐、不生二心的有五万人。
12.en: Of Zebulun, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array with all kinds of instruments of war: fifty thousand who could command and were not of double heart.

12.zh: 拿弗他利支派，有一千军长；跟从他们、拿盾牌和枪的有三万七千人。
12.en: Of Naphtali: one thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty-seven thousand.

12.zh: 但支派，能摆阵的有二万八千六百人。
12.en: Of the Danites who could set the battle in array: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.

12.zh: 亚设支派，能上阵打仗的有四万人。
12.en: Of Asher, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array: forty thousand.

12.zh: 约旦河东的吕便支派、迦得支派、玛拿西半支派，拿着各样兵器打仗的有十二万人。
12.en: On the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle: one hundred twenty thousand.

12.zh: 以上都是能守行伍的战士，他们都诚心来到希伯 ，要立大卫作以色列的王。以色列其余的人也都一心要立大卫作王。
12.en: All these were men of war who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.

12.zh: 他们在那里三日，与大卫一同吃喝，因为他们的族弟兄给他们预备了。
12.en: They were there with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brothers had supplied provisions for them.

12.zh: 靠近他们的人以及以萨迦、西布伦、拿弗他利人将许多面饼、无花果饼、干葡萄、酒、油，用驴、骆驼、骡子、牛驮来，又带了许多的牛和羊来，因为以色列人甚是欢乐。
12.en: Moreover those who were near to them, as far as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali, brought bread on donkeys, on camels, on mules, and on oxen: supplies of flour, cakes of figs, clusters of raisins, wine, oil, cattle, and sheep in abundance; for there was joy in Israel.

13.zh: 大卫与千夫长、百夫长，就是一切首领商议。
13.en: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.

13.zh: 大卫对以色列全会众说：「你们若以为美，见这事是出于耶和华—我们的　神，我们就差遣人走遍以色列地，见我们未来的弟兄，又见住在有郊野之城的祭司利未人，使他们都到这里来聚集。
13.en: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of the LORD our God, let’s send word everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have pasture lands, that they may gather themselves to us.

13.zh: 我们要把　神的[约]柜运到我们这里来；因为在扫罗年间，我们没有在[约]柜前求问　[神]。」
13.en: Also, let’s bring the ark of our God back to us again, for we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”

13.zh: 全会众都说可以如此行；这事在众民眼中都看为好。
13.en: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

13.zh: 于是，大卫将以色列人从埃及的西曷河直到哈马口都招聚了来，要从基列·耶琳将　神的[约]柜运来。
13.en: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.

13.zh: 大卫率领以色列众人上到巴拉，就是属犹大的基列·耶琳，要从那里将[约]柜运来。这[约]柜就是坐在二基路伯上耶和华　神留名的[约]柜。
13.en: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God the LORD’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.

13.zh: 他们将　神的[约]柜从亚比拿达的家里抬出来，放在新车上。乌撒和亚希约赶车。
13.en: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

13.zh: 大卫和以色列众人在　神前用琴、瑟、锣、鼓、号作乐，极力跳舞歌唱。
13.en: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets.

13.zh: 到了基顿的禾场；因为牛失前蹄，乌撒就伸手扶住[约]柜。
13.en: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.

13.zh: 耶和华向他发怒，因他伸手扶住[约]柜击杀他，他就死在　神面前。
13.en: The LORD’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.

13.zh: 大卫因耶和华击杀乌撒，心里愁烦，就称那地方为毗列斯·乌撒，直到今日。
13.en: David was displeased, because the LORD had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.

13.zh: 那日，大卫惧怕　神，说：「　神的[约]柜怎可运到我这里来？」
13.en: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”

13.zh: 于是大卫不将[约]柜运进大卫的城，却运到迦特人俄别·以东的家中。
13.en: So David didn’t move the ark with him into David’s city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.

13.zh: 神的[约]柜在俄别·以东家中三个月，耶和华赐福给俄别·以东的家和他一切所有的。
13.en: God’s ark remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months; and the LORD blessed Obed-Edom’s house and all that he had.

14.zh: 泰尔王希兰将香柏木运到大卫那里，又差遣使者和石匠、木匠给大卫建造宫殿。
14.en: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.

14.zh: 大卫就知道耶和华坚立他作以色列王，又为自己的民以色列，使他的国兴旺。
14.en: David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, for his people Israel’s sake.

14.zh: 大卫在耶路撒冷又立后妃，又生儿女。
14.en: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.

14.zh: 在耶路撒冷所生的众子是沙母亚、朔罢、拿单、所罗门、
14.en: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

14.zh: 以利沙玛、比利雅大、以利法列。
非利士人听见大卫受膏作以色列众人的王，非利士众人就上来寻索大卫。大卫听见，就出去迎敌。
14.en: When the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went out against them.

14.zh: 非利士人来了，布散在利乏音谷。
14.en: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.

14.zh: 大卫求问　神，说：「我可以上去攻打非利士人吗？你将他们交在我手里吗？」耶和华说：「你可以上去，我必将他们交在你手里。」
14.en: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” The LORD said to him, “Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.”

14.zh: 非利士人来到巴力·毗拉心，大卫在那里杀败他们。大卫说：「　神借我的手冲破敌人，如同水冲去一般」；因此称那地方为巴力·毗拉心。
14.en: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like waters breaking out. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

14.zh: 非利士人将神像撇在那里，大卫吩咐人用火焚烧了。
14.en: They left their gods there; and David gave a command, and they were burned with fire.

14.zh: 非利士人又布散在利乏音谷。
14.en: The Philistines made another raid in the valley.

14.zh: 大卫又求问　神。　神说：「不要一直地上去，要转到他们后头，从桑林对面攻打他们。
14.en: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them opposite the mulberry trees.

14.zh: 你听见桑树梢上有脚步的声音，就要出战，因为　神已经在你前头去攻打非利士人的军队。」
14.en: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”

14.zh: 大卫就遵着　神所吩咐的，攻打非利士人的军队，从基遍直到基色。
14.en: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.

14.zh: 于是大卫的名传扬到列国，耶和华使列国都惧怕他。
14.en: The fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him on all nations.

15.zh: 大卫在大卫城为自己建造宫殿，又为　神的[约]柜预备地方，支搭帐幕。
15.en: David made himself houses in David’s city; and he prepared a place for God’s ark, and pitched a tent for it.

15.zh: 那时大卫说：「除了利未人之外，无人可抬　神的[约]柜；因为耶和华拣选他们抬　神的[约]柜，且永远事奉他。」
15.en: Then David said, “No one ought to carry God’s ark but the Levites. For the LORD has chosen them to carry God’s ark, and to minister to him forever.”

15.zh: 大卫招聚以色列众人到耶路撒冷，要将耶和华的[约]柜抬到他所预备的地方。
15.en: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up the LORD’s ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.

15.zh: 大卫又聚集亚伦的子孙和利未人。
15.en: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:

15.zh: 哥辖子孙中有族长乌列和他的弟兄一百二十人。
15.en: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brothers one hundred twenty;

15.zh: 米拉利子孙中有族长亚帅雅和他的弟兄二百二十人。
15.en: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred twenty;

15.zh: 革顺子孙中有族长约珥和他的弟兄一百三十人。
15.en: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brothers one hundred thirty;

15.zh: 以利撒反子孙中有族长示玛雅和他的弟兄二百人。
15.en: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred;

15.zh: 希伯 子孙中有族长以列和他的弟兄八十人。
15.en: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brothers eighty;

15.zh: 乌薛子孙中有族长亚米拿达和他的弟兄一百一十二人。
15.en: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brothers one hundred twelve.

15.zh: 大卫将祭司撒督和亚比亚他，并利未人乌列、亚帅雅、约珥、示玛雅、以列、亚米拿达召来，
15.en: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites: for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,

15.zh: 对他们说：「你们是利未人的族长，你们和你们的弟兄应当自洁，好将耶和华—以色列　神的[约]柜抬到我所预备的地方。
15.en: and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, both you and your brothers, that you may bring the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, up to the place that I have prepared for it.

15.zh: 因你们先前没有[抬这约柜]，按定例求问耶和华—我们的　神，所以他刑罚我们。」
15.en: For because you didn’t carry it at first, the LORD our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him according to the ordinance.”

15.zh: 于是祭司利未人自洁，好将耶和华—以色列　神的[约]柜抬上来。
15.en: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.

15.zh: 利未子孙就用杠，肩抬　神的[约]柜，是照耶和华借摩西所吩咐的。
15.en: The children of the Levites bore God’s ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to the LORD’s word.

15.zh: 大卫吩咐利未人的族长，派他们歌唱的弟兄用琴瑟和钹作乐，欢欢喜喜地大声歌颂。
15.en: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up their voices with joy.

15.zh: 于是利未人派约珥的儿子希幔和他弟兄中比利家的儿子亚萨，并他们族弟兄米拉利子孙里古沙雅的儿子以探。
15.en: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

15.zh: 其次还有他们的弟兄撒迦利雅、便雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、乌尼、以利押、比拿雅、玛西雅、玛他提雅、以利斐利户、弥克尼雅，并守门的俄别·以东和耶利。
