15.en: and with them their brothers of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.

15.zh: 这样，派歌唱的希幔、亚萨、以探敲铜钹，大发响声；
15.en: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud;

15.zh: 派撒迦利雅、雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、乌尼、以利押、玛西雅、比拿雅鼓瑟，调用女音；
15.en: and Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with stringed instruments set to Alamoth;

15.zh: 又派玛他提雅、以利斐利户、弥克尼雅、俄别·以东、耶利、亚撒西雅领首弹琴，调用第八。
15.en: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead.

15.zh: 利未人的族长基拿尼雅是歌唱人的首领，又教训人歌唱，因为他精通此事。
15.en: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the singing. He taught the singers, because he was skillful.

15.zh: 比利家、以利加拿是[约]柜前守门的。
15.en: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.

15.zh: 祭司示巴尼、约沙法、拿坦业、亚玛赛、撒迦利雅、比拿亚、以利以谢在　神的[约]柜前吹号。俄别·以东和耶希亚也是[约]柜前守门的。
15.en: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before God’s ark; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

15.zh: 于是，大卫和以色列的长老，并千夫长都去从俄别·以东的家欢欢喜喜地将耶和华的约柜抬上来。
15.en: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant up out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.

15.zh: 神赐恩与抬耶和华约柜的利未人，他们就献上七只公牛，七只公羊。
15.en: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

15.zh: 大卫和抬[约]柜的利未人，并歌唱人的首领基拿尼雅，以及歌唱的人，都穿着细麻布的外袍；大卫另外穿着细麻布的以弗得。
15.en: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the choir master with the singers; and David had an ephod of linen on him.

15.zh: 这样，以色列众人欢呼吹角、吹号、敲钹、鼓瑟、弹琴，大发响声，将耶和华的约柜抬上来。
15.en: Thus all Israel brought the ark of the LORD’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps.

15.zh: 耶和华的约柜进了大卫城的时候，扫罗的女儿米甲从窗户里观看，见大卫王踊跃跳舞，心里就轻视他。
15.en: As the ark of the LORD’s covenant came to David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.

16.zh: 众人将　神的[约]柜请进去，安放在大卫所搭的帐幕里，就在　神面前献燔祭和平安祭。
16.en: They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.

16.zh: 大卫献完了燔祭和平安祭，就奉耶和华的名给民祝福，
16.en: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the LORD’s name.

16.zh: 并且分给以色列人，无论男女，每人一个饼，一块[肉]，一个葡萄饼。
16.en: He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.

16.zh: 大卫派几个利未人在耶和华的[约]柜前事奉，颂扬，称谢，赞美耶和华—以色列的　神：
16.en: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before the LORD’s ark, and to commemorate, to thank, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel:

16.zh: 为首的是亚萨，其次是撒迦利雅、雅薛、示米拉末、耶歇、玛他提雅、以利押、比拿雅、俄别·以东、耶利，鼓瑟弹琴；惟有亚萨敲钹，大发响声；
16.en: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;

16.zh: 祭司比拿雅和雅哈悉常在　神的约柜前吹号。
16.en: with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.

16.zh: 那日，大卫初次借亚萨和他的弟兄以诗歌称颂耶和华，[说]：
16.en: Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to the LORD by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.

16.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，求告他的名， 在万民中传扬他的作为！
16.en: Oh give thanks to the LORD. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.

16.zh: 要向他唱诗、歌颂， 谈论他一切奇妙的作为。
16.en: Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works.

16.zh: 要以他的圣名夸耀； 寻求耶和华的人，心中应当欢喜。
16.en: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

16.zh: 要寻求耶和华与他的能力， 时常寻求他的面。
16.en: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

16.zh: 他仆人以色列的后裔， 他所拣选雅各的子孙哪， 你们要记念他奇妙的作为和他的奇事， 并他口中的判语。
16.en: Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
you offspring of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

16.zh: 他是耶和华—我们的　神， 全地都有他的判断。
16.en: He is the LORD our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

16.zh: 你们要记念他的约，直到永远； 他所吩咐的话，直到千代，
16.en: Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

16.zh: 就是与亚伯拉罕所立的约， 向以撒所起的誓。
16.en: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac.

16.zh: 他又将这约向雅各定为律例， 向以色列定为永远的约，
16.en: He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

16.zh: 说：我必将迦南地赐给你， 作你产业的分。
16.en: saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance,”

16.zh: 当时你们人丁有限，数目稀少， 并且在那地为寄居的；
16.en: when you were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

16.zh: 他们从这邦游到那邦， 从这国行到那国。
16.en: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

16.zh: 耶和华不容什么人欺负他们， 为他们的缘故责备君王，
16.en: He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

16.zh: 说：不可难为我受膏的人， 也不可恶待我的先知！
16.en: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

16.zh: 全地都要向耶和华歌唱！ 天天传扬他的救恩，
16.en: Sing to the LORD, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.

16.zh: 在列邦中述说他的荣耀， 在万民中述说他的奇事。
16.en: Declare his glory among the nations, and his marvelous works among all the peoples.

16.zh: 因耶和华为大，当受极大的赞美； 他在万神之上，当受敬畏。
16.en: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.

16.zh: 外邦的神都属虚无， 惟独耶和华创造诸天。
16.en: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.

16.zh: 有尊荣和威严在他面前， 有能力和喜乐在他圣所。
16.en: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.

16.zh: 民中的万族啊， 你们要将荣耀能力归给耶和华，都归给耶和华！
16.en: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength!

16.zh: 要将耶和华的名所当得的荣耀归给他， 拿供物来奉到他面前； 当以圣洁的妆饰敬拜耶和华。
16.en: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship the LORD in holy array.

16.zh: 全地要在他面前战抖， 世界也坚定不得动摇。
16.en: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.

16.zh: 愿天欢喜，愿地快乐； 愿人在列邦中说： 耶和华作王了！
16.en: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “The LORD reigns!”

16.zh: 愿海和其中所充满的澎湃； 愿田和其中所有的都欢乐。
16.en: Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field exult, and all that is in it!

16.zh: 那时，林中的树木都要在耶和华面前欢呼， 因为他来要审判全地。
16.en: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth.

16.zh: 应当称谢耶和华； 因他本为善，他的慈爱永远长存！
16.en: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

16.zh: 要说：拯救我们的　神啊，求你救我们， 聚集我们，使我们脱离外邦， 我们好称赞你的圣名，以赞美你为夸胜。
16.en: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise.”

16.zh: 耶和华—以色列的　神， 从亘古直到永远，是应当称颂的！ 众民都说：「阿们！」并且赞美耶和华。
16.en: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting. All the people said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD.

16.zh: 大卫派亚萨和他的弟兄在约柜前常常事奉耶和华，一日尽一日的职分；
16.en: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;

16.zh: 又派俄别·以东和他的弟兄六十八人，与耶杜顿的儿子俄别·以东，并何萨作守门的；
16.en: and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight relatives; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;

16.zh: 且派祭司撒督和他弟兄众祭司在基遍的邱坛、耶和华的帐幕前燔祭坛上，每日早晚，照着耶和华律法书上所吩咐以色列人的，常给耶和华献燔祭。
16.en: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before the LORD’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,
to offer burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in the LORD’s law, which he commanded to Israel;

16.zh: 与他们一同被派的有希幔、耶杜顿，和其余被选名字录在册上的，称谢耶和华，因他的慈爱永远长存。
16.en: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his loving kindness endures forever;

16.zh: 希幔、耶杜顿同着他们吹号、敲钹，大发响声，并用别的乐器随着歌颂　神。耶杜顿的子孙作守门的。
16.en: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.

16.zh: 于是众民各归各家；大卫也回去为家眷祝福。
16.en: All the people departed, each man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.

17.zh: 大卫住在自己宫中，对先知拿单说：「看哪，我住在香柏木的宫中，耶和华的约柜反在幔子里。」
17.en: When David was living in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, “Behold, I live in a cedar house, but the ark of the LORD’s covenant is in a tent.”

17.zh: 拿单对大卫说：「你可以照你的心意而行，因为　神与你同在。」
17.en: Nathan said to David, “Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you.”

17.zh: 当夜，　神的话临到拿单，说：
17.en: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

17.zh: 「你去告诉我仆人大卫，说耶和华如此说：『你不可建造殿宇给我居住。
17.en: “Go and tell David my servant, ‘The LORD says, “You shall not build me a house to dwell in;

17.zh: 自从我领以色列人出埃及，直到今日，我未曾住过殿宇，乃从这会幕到那会幕，从这帐幕[到那帐幕]。
17.en: for I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tent to another.

17.zh: 凡我同以色列人所走的地方，我何曾向以色列的一个士师，就是我吩咐牧养我民的说：你为何不给我建造香柏木的殿宇呢？』
17.en: In all places in which I have walked with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’

17.zh: 现在你要告诉我仆人大卫，说万军之耶和华如此说：『我从羊圈中将你召来，叫你不再跟从羊群，立你作我民以色列的君。
17.en: “Now therefore, you shall tell my servant David, ‘The LORD of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel.

17.zh: 你无论往哪里去，我常与你同在，剪除你的一切仇敌；我必使你得大名，好像世上大大有名的人一样。
17.en: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.

17.zh: 我必为我民以色列选定一个地方，栽培他们，使他们住自己的地方，不再迁移；凶恶之子也不像从前扰害他们，
17.en: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not waste them any more, as at the first,

17.zh: 并不像我命士师治理我民以色列的时候一样。我必治服你的一切仇敌，并且我—耶和华应许你，必为你建立家室。
17.en: and from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover I tell you that the LORD will build you a house.

17.zh: 你寿数满足归你列祖的时候，我必使你的后裔接续你的位，我也必坚定他的国。
17.en: It will happen, when your days are fulfilled that you must go to be with your fathers, that I will set up your offspring after you, who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

17.zh: 他必为我建造殿宇；我必坚定他的国位直到永远。
17.en: He will build me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.

17.zh: 我要作他的父，他要作我的子；并不使我的慈爱离开他，像离开在你以前的扫罗一样。
17.en: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from him who was before you;

17.zh: 我却要将他永远坚立在我家里和我国里；他的国位也必坚定，直到永远。』」
17.en: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne will be established forever.”’”

17.zh: 拿单就按这一切话，照这默示告诉大卫。
17.en: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.

17.zh: 于是大卫王进去，坐在耶和华面前，说：「耶和华　神啊，我是谁，我的家算什么，你竟使我到这地步呢？
17.en: Then David the king went in and sat before the LORD; and he said, “Who am I, LORD God, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?

17.zh: 神啊，这在你眼中还看为小，又应许你仆人的家至于久远。耶和华　神啊，你看顾我好像看顾高贵的人。
17.en: This was a small thing in your eyes, O God, but you have spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have respected me according to the standard of a man of high degree, LORD God.

17.zh: 你加于仆人的尊荣，我还有何言可说呢？因为你知道你的仆人。
17.en: What can David say yet more to you concerning the honor which is done to your servant? For you know your servant.

17.zh: 耶和华啊，你行了这大事，并且显明出来，是因你仆人的缘故，也是照你的心意。
17.en: LORD, for your servant’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.

17.zh: 耶和华啊，照我们耳中听见，没有可比你的，除你以外再无　神。
17.en: LORD, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

17.zh: 世上有何民能比你的民以色列呢？你　神从埃及救赎他们作自己的子民，又在你赎出来的民面前行大而可畏的事，驱逐列邦人，显出你的大名。
17.en: What one nation on the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people whom you redeemed out of Egypt?

17.zh: 你使以色列人作你的子民，直到永远；你—耶和华也作他们的　神。
17.en: For you made your people Israel your own people forever; and you, LORD, became their God.

17.zh: 耶和华啊，你所应许仆人和仆人家的话，求你坚定，直到永远，照你所说的而行。
17.en: Now, LORD, let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, be established forever, and do as you have spoken.

17.zh: 愿你的名永远坚立，被尊为大，说：『万军之耶和华是以色列的　神，是治理以色列的　神。』这样，你仆人大卫的家必在你面前坚立。
17.en: Let your name be established and magnified forever, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel. The house of David your servant is established before you.’

17.zh: 我的　神啊，因你启示仆人说，我必为你建立家室，所以仆人大胆在你面前祈祷。
17.en: For you, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build him a house. Therefore your servant has found courage to pray before you.

17.zh: 耶和华啊，惟有你是　神，你也应许将这福气赐给仆人。
17.en: Now, LORD, you are God, and have promised this good thing to your servant.

17.zh: 现在你喜悦赐福与仆人的家，可以永存在你面前。耶和华啊，你已经赐福，还要赐福到永远。」
17.en: Now it has pleased you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, LORD, have blessed, and it is blessed forever.”

18.zh: 此后，大卫攻打非利士人，把他们治服，从他们手下夺取了迦特和属迦特的村庄；
18.en: After this, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

18.zh: 又攻打摩押，摩押人就归服大卫，给他进贡。
18.en: He defeated Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David and brought tribute.

18.zh: 琐巴王哈大利谢往 幼发拉底河去，要坚定自己的国权，大卫就攻打他，直到哈马，
18.en: David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, toward Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

18.zh: 夺了他的战车一千，马兵七千，步兵二万，将拉战车的马砍断蹄筋，但留下一百辆车的马。
18.en: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them enough for one hundred chariots.

18.zh: 大马士革的亚兰人来帮助琐巴王哈大利谢，大卫就杀了亚兰人二万二千。
18.en: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians.

18.zh: 于是大卫在大马士革的亚兰地设立[防营]，亚兰人就归服他，给他进贡。大卫无论往哪里去，耶和华都使他得胜。
18.en: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David and brought tribute. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

18.zh: 他夺了哈大利谢臣仆所拿的金盾牌带到耶路撒冷。
18.en: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

18.zh: 大卫又从属哈大利谢的提巴和均二城中夺取了许多的铜。后来所罗门用此制造铜海、铜柱，和一切的铜器。
18.en: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.

18.zh: 哈马王陀乌听见大卫杀败琐巴王哈大利谢的全军，
18.en: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,

18.zh: 就打发他儿子哈多兰去见大卫王，问他的安，为他祝福，因为他杀败了哈大利谢（原来陀乌与哈大利谢常常争战）。哈多兰带了金银铜的各样器皿来。
18.en: he sent Hadoram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him (for Hadadezer had wars with Tou); and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.

18.zh: 大卫王将这些器皿，并从各国夺来的金银，就是从以东、摩押、亚扪、非利士、亚玛力人所夺来的，都分别为圣献给耶和华。
18.en: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations: from Edom, from Moab, from the children of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

18.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子亚比筛在盐谷击杀了以东一万八千人。
18.en: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

18.zh: 大卫在以东地设立防营，以东人就都归服他。大卫无论往哪里去，耶和华都使他得胜。
18.en: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

18.zh: 大卫作以色列众人的王，又向众民秉公行义。
18.en: David reigned over all Israel; and he executed justice and righteousness for all his people.

18.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押作元帅；亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官；
18.en: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

18.zh: 亚希突的儿子撒督和亚比亚他的儿子亚希米勒作祭司[长]；沙威沙作书记；
18.en: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was scribe;

18.zh: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅统辖基利提人和比利提人。大卫的众子都在王的左右作领袖。
18.en: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief officials serving the king.

19.zh: 此后，亚扪人的王拿辖死了，他儿子接续他作王。
19.en: After this, Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.

19.zh: 大卫说：「我要照哈嫩的父亲拿辖厚待我的恩典厚待哈嫩。」于是大卫差遣使者为他丧父安慰他。大卫的臣仆到了亚扪人的境内见哈嫩，要安慰他，
19.en: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun to comfort him.

19.zh: 但亚扪人的首领对哈嫩说：「大卫差人来安慰你，你想他是尊敬你父亲吗？他的臣仆来见你不是为详察窥探、倾覆这地吗？」
19.en: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Haven’t his servants come to you to search, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?”

19.zh: 哈嫩便将大卫臣仆[的胡须]剃去[一半]，又割断他们下半截的衣服，使他们露出下体，打发他们回去。
19.en: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks, and sent them away.

19.zh: 有人将臣仆所遇的事告诉大卫，他就差人去迎接他们，因为他们甚觉羞耻；告诉他们说：「可以住在耶利哥，等到胡须长起再回来。」
19.en: Then some people went and told David how the men were treated. He sent to meet them; for the men were greatly humiliated. The king said, “Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”

19.zh: 亚扪人知道大卫憎恶他们，哈嫩和亚扪人就打发人拿一千他连得银子，从美索不达米亚、亚兰、玛迦、琐巴雇战车和马兵，
19.en: When the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.

19.zh: 于是雇了三万二千辆战车和玛迦王并他的军兵；他们来安营在米底巴前。亚扪人也从他们的城里出来，聚集交战。
19.en: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah with his people, who came and encamped near Medeba. The children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

19.zh: 大卫听见了，就差派约押统带勇猛的全军出去。
19.en: When David heard of it, he sent Joab with all the army of the mighty men.

19.zh: 亚扪人出来在城门前摆阵，所来的诸王另在郊野摆阵。
19.en: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.

19.zh: 约押看见敌人在他前后摆阵，就从以色列军中挑选精兵，使他们对着亚兰人摆阵；
19.en: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose some of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.

19.zh: 其余的兵交与他兄弟亚比筛，对着亚扪人摆阵。
19.en: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

19.zh: 约押对亚比筛说：「亚兰人若强过我，你就来帮助我；亚扪人若强过你，我就去帮助你。
19.en: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you are to help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.

19.zh: 我们都当刚强，为本国的民和　神的城邑作大丈夫，愿耶和华凭他的意旨而行。」
19.en: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. May the LORD do that which seems good to him.”

19.zh: 于是约押和跟随他的人前进攻打亚兰人；亚兰人在约押面前逃跑。
19.en: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.

19.zh: 亚扪人见亚兰人逃跑，他们也在约押的兄弟亚比筛面前逃跑进城。约押就回耶路撒冷去了。
19.en: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

19.zh: 亚兰人见自己被以色列人打败，就打发使者将大河那边的亚兰人调来，哈大利谢的将军朔法率领他们。
19.en: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them.

19.zh: 有人告诉大卫，他就聚集以色列众人过约旦河，来到亚兰人那里，迎着他们摆阵。大卫既摆阵攻击亚兰人，亚兰人就与他打仗。
19.en: David was told that, so he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, came to them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

19.zh: 亚兰人在以色列人面前逃跑。大卫杀了亚兰七千辆战车[的人]，四万步兵，又杀了亚兰的将军朔法。
19.en: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed of the Syrian men seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand footmen, and also killed Shophach the captain of the army.

19.zh: 属哈大利谢[的诸王]见自己被以色列人打败，就与大卫和好，归服他。于是亚兰人不敢再帮助亚扪人了。
19.en: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and served him. The Syrians would not help the children of Ammon any more.

20.zh: 过了一年，到列王出战的时候，约押率领军兵毁坏亚扪人的地，围攻拉巴；大卫仍住在耶路撒冷。约押攻打拉巴，将城倾覆。
20.en: At the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, Joab led out the army and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. Joab struck Rabbah, and overthrew it.

20.zh: 大卫夺了亚扪人之王所戴的金冠冕，其上的金子重一他连得，又嵌着宝石；人将这冠冕戴在大卫头上。大卫从城里夺了许多财物，
20.en: David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it. It was set on David’s head, and he brought very much plunder out of the city.

20.zh: 将城里的人拉出来，放在锯下，或铁耙下，或[铁]斧下，大卫待亚扪各城的居民都是如此。其后大卫和众军都回耶路撒冷去了。
20.en: He brought out the people who were in it, and had them cut with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. David did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

20.zh: 后来，以色列人在基色与非利士人打仗。户沙人西比该杀了伟人的一个儿子细派，非利士人就被制伏了。
20.en: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.

20.zh: 又与非利士人打仗。睚珥的儿子伊勒哈难杀了迦特人歌利亚的兄弟拉哈米；这人的枪杆粗如织布的机轴。
20.en: Again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

20.zh: 又在迦特打仗。那里有一个身量高大的人，手脚都是六指，共有二十四个指头，他也是伟人的儿子。
20.en: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand and six on each foot; and he also was born to the giant.

20.zh: 这人向以色列人骂阵，大卫的哥哥示米亚的儿子约拿单就杀了他。
20.en: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.

20.zh: 这三个人是迦特伟人的儿子，都死在大卫和他仆人的手下。
20.en: These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

21.zh: 撒但起来攻击以色列人，激动大卫数点他们。
21.en: Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to take a census of Israel.

21.zh: 大卫就吩咐约押和民中的首领说：「你们去数点以色列人，从别是巴直到但，回来告诉我，我好知道他们的数目。」
21.en: David said to Joab and to the princes of the people, “Go, count Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring me word, that I may know how many there are.”

21.zh: 约押说：「愿耶和华使他的百姓比现在加增百倍。我主我王啊，他们不都是你的仆人吗？我主为何吩咐行这事，为何使以色列人陷在罪里呢？」
21.en: Joab said, “May the LORD make his people a hundred times as many as they are. But, my lord the king, aren’t they all my lord’s servants? Why does my lord require this thing? Why will he be a cause of guilt to Israel?”

21.zh: 但王的命令胜过约押。约押就出去，走遍以色列地，回到耶路撒冷，
21.en: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, then came to Jerusalem.

21.zh: 将百姓的总数奏告大卫：以色列人拿刀的有一百一十万；犹大人拿刀的有四十七万。
21.en: Joab gave the sum of the census of the people to David. All those of Israel were one million one hundred thousand men who drew a sword; and in Judah were four hundred seventy thousand men who drew a sword.

21.zh: 惟有利未人和便雅悯人没有数在其中，因为约押厌恶王的这命令。
21.en: But he didn’t count Levi and Benjamin among them, for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.

21.zh: 神不喜悦这数点百姓的事，便降灾给以色列人。
21.en: God was displeased with this thing; therefore he struck Israel.

21.zh: 大卫祷告　神说：「我行这事大有罪了！现在求你除掉仆人的罪孽，因我所行的甚是愚昧。」
21.en: David said to God, “I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing. But now put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant, for I have done very foolishly.”

21.zh: 耶和华吩咐大卫的先见迦得说：
21.en: The LORD spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,

21.zh: 「你去告诉大卫说，耶和华如此说：我有三样灾，随你选择一样，我好降与你。」
21.en: “Go and speak to David, saying, ‘The LORD says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”

21.zh: 于是，迦得来见大卫，对他说：「耶和华如此说：『你可以随意选择：
21.en: So Gad came to David and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Take your choice:

21.zh: 或三年的饥荒；或败在你敌人面前，被敌人的刀追杀三个月；或在你国中有耶和华的刀，就是三日的瘟疫，耶和华的使者在以色列的四境施行毁灭。』现在你要想一想，我好回复那差我来的。」
21.en: either three years of famine; or three months to be consumed before your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtakes you; or else three days of the sword of the LORD, even pestilence in the land, and the LORD’s angel destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.’”

21.zh: 大卫对迦得说：「我甚为难。我愿落在耶和华的手里，因为他有丰盛的怜悯；我不愿落在人的手里。」
21.en: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let me fall, I pray, into the LORD’s hand, for his mercies are very great. Don’t let me fall into man’s hand.”

21.zh: 于是，耶和华降瘟疫与以色列人，以色列人就死了七万。
21.en: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.

21.zh: 神差遣使者去灭耶路撒冷，刚要灭的时候，耶和华看见后悔，就不降这灾了，吩咐灭城的天使说：「够了，住手吧！」那时，耶和华的使者站在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场那里。
21.en: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was about to destroy, the LORD saw, and he relented of the disaster, and said to the destroying angel, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” the LORD’s angel was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

21.zh: 大卫举目，看见耶和华的使者站在天地间，手里有拔出来的刀，伸在耶路撒冷以上。大卫和长老都身穿麻衣，面伏于地。
21.en: David lifted up his eyes, and saw the LORD’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.

21.zh: 大卫祷告　神说：「吩咐数点百姓的不是我吗？我犯了罪，行了恶，但这群羊做了什么呢？愿耶和华—我　神的手攻击我和我的父家，不要攻击你的民，降瘟疫与他们。」
21.en: David said to God, “Isn’t it I who commanded the people to be counted? It is even I who have sinned and done very wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand, O LORD my God, be against me and against my father’s house; but not against your people, that they should be plagued.”

21.zh: 耶和华的使者吩咐迦得去告诉大卫，叫他上去，在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场上为耶和华筑一座坛；
21.en: Then the LORD’s angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

21.zh: 大卫就照着迦得奉耶和华名所说的话上去了。
21.en: David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in the LORD’s name.

21.zh: 那时阿珥楠正打麦子，回头看见天使，就和他四个儿子都藏起来了。
21.en: Ornan turned back and saw the angel; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

21.zh: 大卫到了阿珥楠那里，阿珥楠看见大卫，就从禾场上出去，脸伏于地，向他下拜。
21.en: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.

21.zh: 大卫对阿珥楠说：「你将这禾场与相连之地卖给我，我必给你足价，我好在其上为耶和华筑一座坛，使民间的瘟疫止住。」
21.en: Then David said to Ornan, “Sell me the place of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to the LORD on it. You shall sell it to me for the full price, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”

21.zh: 阿珥楠对大卫说：「你可以用这禾场，愿我主我王照你所喜悦的去行。我也将牛给你作燔祭，把打粮的器具当柴烧，拿麦子作素祭。这些我都送给你。」
21.en: Ornan said to David, “Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes. Behold, I give the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal offering. I give it all.”

21.zh: 大卫王对阿珥楠说：「不然！我必要用足价向你买。我不用你的物献给耶和华，也不用白得之物献为燔祭。」
21.en: King David said to Ornan, “No, but I will most certainly buy it for the full price. For I will not take that which is yours for the LORD, nor offer a burnt offering that costs me nothing.”

21.zh: 于是大卫为那块地平了六百舍客勒金子给阿珥楠。
21.en: So David gave to Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.

21.zh: 大卫在那里为耶和华筑了一座坛，献燔祭和平安祭，求告耶和华。耶和华就应允他，使火从天降在燔祭坛上。
21.en: David built an altar to the LORD there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called on the LORD; and he answered him from the sky by fire on the altar of burnt offering.

21.zh: 耶和华吩咐使者，他就收刀入鞘。
21.en: Then the LORD commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.

21.zh: 那时，大卫见耶和华在耶布斯人阿珥楠的禾场上应允了他，就在那里献祭。
21.en: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

21.zh: 摩西在旷野所造之耶和华的帐幕和燔祭坛都在基遍的高处；
21.en: For the LORD’s tabernacle, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.

21.zh: 只是大卫不敢前去求问　神，因为惧怕耶和华使者的刀。
21.en: But David couldn’t go before it to inquire of God, for he was afraid because of the sword of the LORD’s angel.

22.zh: 大卫说：「这就是耶和华　神的殿，为以色列人献燔祭的坛。」
22.en: Then David said, “This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”

22.zh: 大卫吩咐聚集住以色列地的外邦人，从其中派石匠凿石头，要建造　神的殿。
22.en: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God’s house.

22.zh: 大卫预备许多铁做门上的钉子和钩子，又预备许多铜，多得无法可称；
22.en: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the couplings, and bronze in abundance without weight,

22.zh: 又预备无数的香柏木，因为西顿人和泰尔人给大卫运了许多香柏木来。
22.en: and cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.

22.zh: 大卫说：「我儿子所罗门还年幼娇嫩，要为耶和华建造的殿宇必须高大辉煌，使名誉荣耀传遍万国；所以我要为殿预备材料。」于是，大卫在未死之先预备的材料甚多。
22.en: David said, “Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries. I will therefore make preparation for it.” So David prepared abundantly before his death.

22.zh: 大卫召了他儿子所罗门来，嘱咐他给耶和华—以色列的　神建造殿宇，
22.en: Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.

22.zh: 对所罗门说：「我儿啊，我心里本想为耶和华—我　神的名建造殿宇，
22.en: David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of the LORD my God.

22.zh: 只是耶和华的话临到我说：『你流了多人的血，打了多次大仗，你不可为我的名建造殿宇，因为你在我眼前使多人的血流在地上。
22.en: But the LORD’s word came to me, saying, ‘You have shed blood abundantly and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.

22.zh: 你要生一个儿子，他必作太平的人；我必使他安静，不被四围的仇敌扰乱。他的名要叫所罗门。他在位的日子，我必使以色列人平安康泰。
22.en: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.

22.zh: 他必为我的名建造殿宇。他要作我的子；我要作他的父。他作以色列王；我必坚定他的国位，直到永远。』
22.en: He shall build a house for my name; and he will be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’

22.zh: 我儿啊，现今愿耶和华与你同在，使你亨通，照他指着你说的话，建造耶和华—你　神的殿。
22.en: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you and prosper you, and build the house of the LORD your God, as he has spoken concerning you.

22.zh: 但愿耶和华赐你聪明智慧，好治理以色列国，遵行耶和华—你　神的律法。
22.en: May the LORD give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the law of the LORD your God.

22.zh: 你若谨守遵行耶和华借摩西吩咐以色列的律例典章，就得亨通。你当刚强壮胆，不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。
22.en: Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which the LORD gave Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.

22.zh: 我在困难之中为耶和华的殿预备了金子十万他连得，银子一百万他连得，铜和铁多得无法可称；我也预备了木头、石头，你还可以增添。
22.en: Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for the LORD’s house one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million talents of silver, and bronze and iron without weight; for it is in abundance. I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to them.

22.zh: 你有许多匠人，就是石匠、木匠，和一切能做各样工的巧匠，
22.en: There are also workmen with you in abundance—cutters and workers of stone and timber, and all kinds of men who are skillful in every kind of work;

22.zh: 并有无数的金银铜铁。你当起来办事，愿耶和华与你同在。」
22.en: of the gold, the silver, the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may the LORD be with you.”

22.zh: 大卫又吩咐以色列的众首领帮助他儿子所罗门，[说]：
22.en: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,

22.zh: 「耶和华—你们的　神不是与你们同在吗？不是叫你们四围都平安吗？因他已将这地的居民交在我手中，这地就在耶和华与他百姓面前制伏了。
22.en: “Isn’t the LORD your God with you? Hasn’t he given you rest on every side? For he has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD and before his people.

22.zh: 现在你们应当立定心意，寻求耶和华—你们的　神；也当起来建造耶和华　神的圣所，好将耶和华的约柜和供奉　神的圣器皿都搬进为耶和华名建造的殿里。」
22.en: Now set your heart and your soul to follow the LORD your God. Arise therefore, and build the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant and the holy vessels of God into the house that is to be built for the LORD’s name.”

23.zh: 大卫年纪老迈，日子满足，就立他儿子所罗门作以色列的王。
23.en: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

23.zh: 大卫招聚以色列的众首领和祭司利未人。
23.en: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

23.zh: 利未人从三十岁以外的都被数点，他们男丁的数目共有三万八千；
23.en: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.

23.zh: 其中有二万四千人管理耶和华殿的事，有六千人作官长和士师，
23.en: David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of the LORD’s house, six thousand were officers and judges,

23.zh: 有四千人作守门的，又有四千人用大卫所做的乐器颂赞耶和华。
23.en: four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”

23.zh: 大卫将利未人革顺、哥辖、米拉利的子孙分了班次。
23.en: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

23.zh: 革顺的子孙有拉但和示每。
23.en: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

23.zh: 拉但的长子是耶歇，还有细坦和约珥，共三人。
23.en: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel, three.

23.zh: 示每的儿子是示罗密、哈薛、哈兰三人。这是拉但族的族长。
23.en: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.

23.zh: 示每的儿子是雅哈、细拿、耶乌施、比利亚共四人。
23.en: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

23.zh: 雅哈是长子，细撒是次子。但耶乌施和比利亚的子孙不多，所以算为一族。
23.en: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.

23.zh: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦、乌薛共四人。
23.en: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

23.zh: 暗兰的儿子是亚伦、摩西。亚伦和他的子孙分出来，好分别至圣的物，在耶和华面前烧香、事奉他，奉他的名祝福，直到永远。
23.en: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.

23.zh: 至于神人摩西，他的子孙名字记在利未支派的册上。
23.en: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.

23.zh: 摩西的儿子是革舜和以利以谢。
23.en: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

23.zh: 革舜的长子是细布业；
23.en: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.

23.zh: 以利以谢的儿子是利哈比雅。以利以谢没有别的儿子，但利哈比雅的子孙甚多。
23.en: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

23.zh: 以斯哈的长子是示罗密。
23.en: The son of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.

23.zh: 希伯伦的长子是耶利雅，次子是亚玛利亚，三子是雅哈悉，四子是耶加面。
23.en: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

23.zh: 乌薛的长子是米迦，次子是耶西雅。
23.en: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.

23.zh: 米拉利的儿子是抹利、母示。抹利的儿子是以利亚撒、基士。
23.en: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

23.zh: 以利亚撒死了，没有儿子，只有女儿，他们本族基士的儿子娶了她们为妻。
23.en: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only; and their relatives, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.

23.zh: 母示的儿子是末力、以得、耶利摩共三人。
23.en: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

23.zh: 以上利未子孙作族长的，照着男丁的数目，从二十岁以外，都办耶和华殿的事务。
23.en: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of the LORD’s house, from twenty years old and upward.

23.zh: 大卫说：「耶和华—以色列的　神已经使他的百姓平安，他永远住在耶路撒冷。
23.en: For David said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people; and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.

23.zh: 利未人不必再抬帐幕和其中所用的一切器皿了。」
23.en: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”

23.zh: 照着大卫临终所吩咐的，利未人从二十岁以外的都被数点。
23.en: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were counted, from twenty years old and upward.

23.zh: 他们的职任是服事亚伦的子孙，在耶和华的殿和院子，并屋中办事，洁净一切圣物，就是办　神殿的事务，
23.en: For their duty was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the LORD’s house—in the courts, in the rooms, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of God’s house;

23.zh: 并管理陈设饼，素祭的细面，或无酵薄饼，或用盘烤，或用油调和的物，又管理各样的升斗尺度；
23.en: for the show bread also, and for the fine flour for a meal offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all measurements of quantity and size;

23.zh: 每日早晚，站立称谢赞美耶和华，
23.en: and to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise in the evening;

23.zh: 又在安息日、月朔，并节期，按数照例，将燔祭常常献给耶和华；
23.en: and to offer all burnt offerings to the LORD on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually before the LORD;

23.zh: 又看守会幕和圣所，并守[耶和华]吩咐他们弟兄亚伦子孙的，办耶和华殿的事。
23.en: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of Aaron their brothers for the service of the LORD’s house.

24.zh: 亚伦子孙的班次记在下面：亚伦的儿子是拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛。
24.en: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

24.zh: 拿答、亚比户死在他们父亲之先，没有留下儿子；故此，以利亚撒、以他玛供祭司的职分。
24.en: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.

24.zh: 以利亚撒的子孙撒督和以他玛的子孙亚希米勒，同着大卫将他们的族弟兄分成班次。
24.en: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.

24.zh: 以利亚撒子孙中为首的比以他玛子孙中为首的更多，分班如下：以利亚撒的子孙中有十六个族长，以他玛的子孙中有八个族长；
24.en: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and they were divided like this: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.

24.zh: 都掣签分立，彼此一样。在圣所和　神面前作首领的有以利亚撒的子孙，也有以他玛的子孙。
24.en: Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

24.zh: 作书记的利未人拿坦业的儿子示玛雅在王和首领，与祭司撒督、亚比亚他的儿子亚希米勒，并祭司利未人的族长面前记录他们的名字。在以利亚撒的子孙中取一族，在以他玛的子孙中取一族。
24.en: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

24.zh: 掣签的时候，第一掣出来的是耶何雅立，第二是耶大雅，
24.en: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

24.zh: 第三是哈琳，第四是梭琳，
24.en: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

24.zh: 第五是玛基雅，第六是米雅民，
24.en: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

24.zh: 第七是哈歌斯，第八是亚比雅，
24.en: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

24.zh: 第九是耶书亚，第十是示迦尼，
24.en: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

24.zh: 第十一是以利亚实，第十二是雅金，
24.en: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

24.zh: 第十三是胡巴，第十四是耶是比押，
24.en: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

24.zh: 第十五是璧迦，第十六是音麦，
24.en: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

24.zh: 第十七是希悉，第十八是哈辟悉，
24.en: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,

24.zh: 第十九是毗他希雅，第二十是以西结，
24.en: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,

24.zh: 第二十一是雅斤，第二十二是迦末，
24.en: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,

24.zh: 第二十三是第来雅，第二十四是玛西亚。
24.en: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.

24.zh: 这就是他们的班次，要照耶和华—以色列的　神借他们祖宗亚伦所吩咐的条例进入耶和华的殿办理事务。
24.en: This was their ordering in their service, to come into the LORD’s house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father, as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded him.

24.zh: 利未其余的子孙如下：暗兰的子孙里有书巴业；书巴业的子孙里有耶希底亚。
24.en: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

24.zh: 利哈比雅的子孙里有长子伊示雅。
24.en: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.

24.zh: 以斯哈的子孙里有示罗摩；示罗摩的子孙里有雅哈。
24.en: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.

24.zh: [希伯伦 的]子孙里有[长子]耶利雅，次子亚玛利亚，三子雅哈悉，四子耶加面。
24.en: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

24.zh: 乌薛的子孙里有米迦；米迦的子孙里有沙密。
24.en: The sons of Uzziel: Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.

24.zh: 米迦的兄弟是伊示雅；伊示雅的子孙里有撒迦利雅。
24.en: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.

24.zh: 米拉利的儿子是抹利、母示、[雅西雅]；雅西雅的儿子有比挪；
24.en: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.

24.zh: 米拉利的子孙里有雅西雅的儿子比挪、朔含、撒刻、伊比利。
24.en: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.

24.zh: 抹利的儿子是以利亚撒；以利亚撒没有儿子。
24.en: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

24.zh: 基士的子孙里有耶拉篾。
24.en: Of Kish, the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.

24.zh: 母示的儿子是末力、以得、耶利摩。按着宗族这都是利未的子孙。
24.en: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.

24.zh: 他们在大卫王和撒督，并亚希米勒与祭司利未人的族长面前掣签，正如他们弟兄亚伦的子孙一般。各族的长者与兄弟没有分别。
24.en: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites, the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.

25.zh: 大卫和众首领分派亚萨、希幔，并耶杜顿的子孙弹琴、鼓瑟、敲钹、唱歌。他们供职的人数记在下面：
25.en: Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who were to prophesy with harps, with stringed instruments, and with cymbals. The number of those who did the work according to their service was:

25.zh: 亚萨的儿子撒刻、约瑟、尼探雅、亚萨利拉都归亚萨指教，遵王的旨意唱歌。
25.en: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. The sons of Asaph were under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied at the order of the king.

25.zh: 耶杜顿的儿子基大利、西利、耶筛亚、哈沙比雅、玛他提雅、示每共六人，都归他们父亲耶杜顿指教，弹琴，唱歌，称谢，颂赞耶和华。
25.en: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising the LORD with the harp.

25.zh: 希幔的儿子布基雅、玛探雅、乌薛、细布业、耶利摩、哈拿尼雅、哈拿尼、以利亚他、基大利提、罗幔提·以谢、约施比加沙、玛罗提、何提、玛哈秀；
25.en: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.

25.zh: 这都是希幔的儿子，吹角颂赞。希幔奉　神之命作王的先见。　神赐给希幔十四个儿子，三个女儿，
25.en: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

25.zh: 都归他们父亲指教，在耶和华的殿唱歌、敲钹、弹琴、鼓瑟，办　神殿的事务。亚萨、耶杜顿、希幔都是王所命定的。
25.en: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the LORD’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God’s house: Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.

25.zh: 他们和他们的弟兄学习颂赞耶和华；善于歌唱的共有二百八十八人。
25.en: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to the LORD, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.

25.zh: 这些人无论大小，为师的、为徒的，都一同掣签分了班次。
25.en: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.

25.zh: 掣签的时候，第一掣出来的是亚萨的儿子约瑟。第二是基大利；他和他弟兄并儿子共十二人。
25.en: Now the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, he and his brothers and sons were twelve;

25.zh: 第三是撒刻；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the third to Zaccur, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

25.zh: 第四是伊洗利；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the fourth to Izri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

25.zh: 第五是尼探雅；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

25.zh: 第六是布基雅；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

25.zh: 第七是耶萨利拉；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the seventh to Jesharelah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

25.zh: 第八是耶筛亚；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

25.zh: 第九是玛探雅；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

25.zh: 第十是示每；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

25.zh: 第十一是亚萨烈；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

25.zh: 第十二是哈沙比雅；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

25.zh: 第十三是书巴业；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: for the thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

25.zh: 第十四是玛他提雅；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: for the fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

25.zh: 第十五是耶利摩；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: for the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

25.zh: 第十六是哈拿尼雅；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: for the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

25.zh: 第十七是约施比加沙；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: for the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

25.zh: 第十八是哈拿尼；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: for the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

25.zh: 第十九是玛罗提；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: for the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

25.zh: 第二十是以利亚他；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: for the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

25.zh: 第二十一是何提；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: for the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

25.zh: 第二十二是基大利提；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: for the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

25.zh: 第二十三是玛哈秀；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: for the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

25.zh: 第二十四是罗幔提·以谢；他和他儿子并弟兄共十二人。
25.en: for the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.

26.zh: 守门的班次记在下面：可拉族亚萨的子孙中，有可利的儿子米施利米雅。
26.en: For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

26.zh: 米施利米雅的长子是撒迦利亚，次子是耶叠，三子是西巴第雅，四子是耶提聂，
26.en: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

26.zh: 五子是以拦，六子是约哈难，七子是以利约乃。
26.en: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.

26.zh: 俄别·以东的长子是示玛雅，次子是约萨拔，三子是约亚，四子是沙甲，五子是拿坦业，
26.en: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

26.zh: 六子是亚米利，七子是以萨迦，八子是毗乌利太，因为　神赐福与俄别·以东。
26.en: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.

26.zh: 他的儿子示玛雅有几个儿子，都是大能的壮士，掌管父亲的家。
26.en: Sons were also born to Shemaiah his son, who ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.

26.zh: 示玛雅的儿子是俄得尼、利法益、俄备得、以利萨巴。以利萨巴的弟兄是壮士，还有以利户和西玛迦。
26.en: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose relatives were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

26.zh: 这都是俄别·以东的子孙，他们和他们的儿子并弟兄，都是善于办事的壮士。俄别·以东的子孙共六十二人。
26.en: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom with their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.

26.zh: 米施利米雅的儿子和弟兄都是壮士，共十八人。
26.en: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.

26.zh: 米拉利子孙何萨有几个儿子：长子是申利，他原不是长子，是他父亲立他作长子。
26.en: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),

26.zh: 次子是希勒家，三子是底巴利雅，四子是撒迦利亚。何萨的儿子并弟兄共十三人。
26.en: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.

26.zh: 这些人都是守门的班长，与他们的弟兄一同在耶和华殿里按班供职。
26.en: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in the LORD’s house.

26.zh: 他们无论大小，都按着宗族掣签分守各门。
26.en: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.

26.zh: 掣签守东门的是示利米雅；他的儿子撒迦利亚是精明的谋士，掣签守北门。
26.en: The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

26.zh: 俄别·以东守南门，他的儿子守库房。
26.en: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.

26.zh: 书聘与何萨守西门，在靠近沙利基门、通着往上去的街道上，班与班相对。
26.en: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.

26.zh: 每日东门有六个利未人，北门有四个，南门有四个，库房有两个，又有两个轮班替换。
26.en: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.

26.zh: 在西面街道上有四个，在游廊上有两个。
26.en: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

26.zh: 以上是可拉子孙和米拉利子孙守门的班次。
26.en: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.

26.zh: 利未子孙中有亚希雅掌管　神殿的府库和圣物的府库。
26.en: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God’s house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

26.zh: 革顺族、拉但子孙里，作族长的是革顺族拉但的子孙耶希伊利。
26.en: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.

26.zh: 耶希伊利的儿子西坦和他兄弟约珥掌管耶和华殿里的府库。
26.en: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of the LORD’s house.

26.zh: 暗兰族、以斯哈族、希伯伦族、乌泄族[也有职分]。
26.en: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:

26.zh: 摩西的孙子、革舜的儿子细布业掌管府库。
26.en: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries.

26.zh: 还有他的弟兄以利以谢。以利以谢的儿子是利哈比雅；利哈比雅的儿子是耶筛亚；耶筛亚的儿子是约兰；约兰的儿子是细基利；细基利的儿子是示罗密。
26.en: His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.

26.zh: 这示罗密和他的弟兄掌管府库的圣物，就是大卫王和众族长、千夫长、百夫长，并军长所分别为圣的物。
26.en: This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’ households, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.

26.zh: 他们将争战时所夺的财物分别为圣，以备修造耶和华的殿。
26.en: They dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair the LORD’s house.

26.zh: 先见撒母耳、基士的儿子扫罗、尼珥的儿子押尼珥、洗鲁雅的儿子约押所分别为圣的物都归示罗密和他的弟兄掌管。
26.en: All that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated, whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth and of his brothers.

26.zh: 以斯哈族有基拿尼雅和他众子作官长和士师，管理以色列的外事。
26.en: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

26.zh: 希伯伦族有哈沙比雅和他弟兄一千七百人，都是壮士，在约旦河西、以色列地办理耶和华与王的事。
26.en: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of the LORD and for the service of the king.

26.zh: 希伯伦族中有耶利雅作族长。大卫作王第四十年，在基列的雅谢，从这族中寻得大能的勇士。
26.en: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.

26.zh: 耶利雅的弟兄有二千七百人，都是壮士，且作族长；大卫王派他们在吕便支派、迦得支派、玛拿西半支派中办理　神和王的事。
26.en: His relatives, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.

27.zh: 以色列人的族长、千夫长、百夫长，和官长都分定班次，每班是二万四千人，周年按月轮流，替换出入服事王。
27.en: Now the children of Israel after their number, the heads of fathers’ households and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year—of every division were twenty-four thousand.

27.zh: 正月第一班的班长是撒巴第业的儿子雅朔班；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

27.zh: 他是法勒斯的子孙，统管正月[班]的一切军长。
27.en: He was of the children of Perez, the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.

27.zh: 二月的班长是亚哈希人朵代，还有副官密基罗；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: Over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite and his division, and Mikloth the ruler; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

27.zh: 三月第三班的班长是祭司耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the chief priest. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

27.zh: 这比拿雅是那三十人中的勇士，管理那三十人；他班内又有他儿子暗米萨拔。
27.en: This is that Benaiah who was the mighty man of the thirty and over the thirty. Of his division was Ammizabad his son.

27.zh: 四月第四班的班长是约押的兄弟亚撒黑。接续他的是他儿子西巴第雅；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

27.zh: 五月第五班的班长是伊斯拉人珊合；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

27.zh: 六月第六班的班长是提哥亚人益吉的儿子以拉；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

27.zh: 七月第七班的班长是以法莲族比伦人希利斯；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

27.zh: 八月第八班的班长是谢拉族户沙人西比该；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

27.zh: 九月第九班的班长是便雅悯族亚拿突人亚比以谢；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

27.zh: 十月第十班的班长是谢拉族尼陀法人玛哈莱；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

27.zh: 十一月第十一班的班长是以法莲族比拉顿人比拿雅；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

27.zh: 十二月第十二班的班长是俄陀聂族尼陀法人黑玳；他班内有二万四千人。
27.en: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

27.zh: 管理以色列众支派的记在下面：管吕便人的是细基利的儿子以利以谢；管西缅人的是玛迦的儿子示法提雅；
27.en: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: of the Reubenites, Eliezer the son of Zichri was the ruler; of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah;

27.zh: 管利未人的是基母利的儿子哈沙比雅；管亚伦子孙的是撒督；
27.en: of Levi, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; of Aaron, Zadok;

27.zh: 管犹大人的是大卫的一个哥哥以利户；管以萨迦人的是米迦勒的儿子暗利；
27.en: of Judah, Elihu, one of the brothers of David; of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael;

27.zh: 管西布伦人的是俄巴第雅的儿子伊施玛雅；管拿弗他利人的是亚斯列的儿子耶利摩；
27.en: of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah; of Naphtali, Jeremoth the son of Azriel;

27.zh: 管以法莲人的是阿撒细雅的儿子何细亚；管玛拿西半支派的是毗大雅的儿子约珥；
27.en: of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;

27.zh: 管基列地玛拿西那半支派的是撒迦利亚的儿子易多；管便雅悯人的是押尼珥的儿子雅西业；
27.en: of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah; of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner;

27.zh: 管但人的是耶罗罕的儿子亚萨列。以上是以色列众支派的首领。
27.en: of Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.

27.zh: 以色列人二十岁以内的，大卫没有记其数目；因耶和华曾应许说，必加增以色列人如天上的星那样多。
27.en: But David didn’t take the number of them from twenty years old and under, because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like the stars of the sky.

27.zh: 洗鲁雅的儿子约押动手数点，当时[耶和华]的烈怒临到以色列人；因此，没有点完，数目也没有写在大卫王记上。
27.en: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to take a census, but didn’t finish; and wrath came on Israel for this. The number wasn’t put into the account in the chronicles of King David.

27.zh: 掌管王府库的是亚叠的儿子押斯马威。掌管田野城邑村庄保障之仓库的是乌西雅的儿子约拿单。
27.en: Over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel. Over the treasures in the fields, in the cities, in the villages, and in the towers was Jonathan the son of Uzziah;

27.zh: 掌管耕田种地的是基绿的儿子以斯利。
27.en: Over those who did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub.

27.zh: 掌管葡萄园的是拉玛人示每。掌管葡萄园酒窖的是实弗米人撒巴底。
27.en: Over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite. Over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite.

27.zh: 掌管高原橄榄树和桑树的是基第利人巴勒·哈南。掌管油库的是约阿施。
27.en: Over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the lowland was Baal Hanan the Gederite. Over the cellars of oil was Joash.

27.zh: 掌管沙 牧放牛群的是沙 人施提赉。掌管山谷牧养牛群的是亚第赉的儿子沙法。
27.en: Over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite. Over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai.

27.zh: 掌管驼[群]的是以实玛利人阿比勒。掌管驴[群]的是米 人耶希底亚。掌管羊群的是夏甲人雅悉。
27.en: Over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite. Over the donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite. Over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite.

27.zh: 这都是给大卫王掌管产业的。
27.en: All these were the rulers of the property which was King David’s.

27.zh: 大卫的叔叔约拿单作谋士；这人有智慧，又作书记。哈摩尼的儿子耶歇作王众子的师傅。
27.en: Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe. Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons.

27.zh: 亚希多弗也作王的谋士。亚基人户筛作王的陪伴。
27.en: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.

27.zh: 亚希多弗之后，有比拿雅的儿子耶何耶大和亚比亚他接续他[作谋士]。约押作王的元帅。
27.en: After Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. Joab was the captain of the king’s army.

28.zh: 大卫招聚以色列各支派的首领和轮班服事王的军长，与千夫长、百夫长，掌管王和王子产业牲畜的，并太监，以及大能的勇士，都到耶路撒冷来。
28.en: David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, the captains of the companies who served the king by division, the captains of thousands, the captains of hundreds, and the rulers over all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the officers and the mighty men, even all the mighty men of valor, to Jerusalem.

28.zh: 大卫王就站起来，说：「我的弟兄，我的百姓啊，你们当听我言，我心里本想建造殿宇，安放耶和华的约柜，作为我　神的脚凳；我已经预备建造的材料。
28.en: Then David the king stood up on his feet and said, “Hear me, my brothers and my people! As for me, it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the LORD’s covenant, and for the footstool of our God; and I had prepared for the building.

28.zh: 只是　神对我说：『你不可为我的名建造殿宇；因你是战士，流了人的血。』
28.en: But God said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for my name, because you are a man of war and have shed blood.’

28.zh: 然而，耶和华—以色列的　神在我父的全家拣选我作以色列的王，直到永远。因他拣选犹大为首领；在犹大支派中拣选我父家，在我父的众子里喜悦我，立我作以色列众人的王。
28.en: However the LORD, the God of Israel, chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever. For he has chosen Judah to be prince; and in the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel.

28.zh: 耶和华赐我许多儿子，在我儿子中拣选所罗门坐耶和华的国位，治理以色列人。
28.en: Of all my sons (for the LORD has given me many sons), he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the LORD’s kingdom over Israel.

28.zh: 耶和华对我说：『你儿子所罗门必建造我的殿和院宇；因为我拣选他作我的子，我也必作他的父。
28.en: He said to me, ‘Solomon, your son, shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

28.zh: 他若恒久遵行我的诫命典章如今日一样，我就必坚定他的国位，直到永远。』
28.en: I will establish his kingdom forever if he continues to do my commandments and my ordinances, as it is today.’

28.zh: 现今在耶和华的会中，以色列众人眼前所说的，我们的　神也听见了。你们应当寻求耶和华—你们　神的一切诫命，谨守遵行，如此你们可以承受这美地，遗留给你们的子孙，永远为业。
28.en: Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, the LORD’s assembly, and in the audience of our God, observe and seek out all the commandments of the LORD your God, that you may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children after you forever.

28.zh: 「我儿所罗门哪，你当认识耶和华—你父的　神，诚心乐意地事奉他；因为他鉴察众人的心，知道一切心思意念。你若寻求他，他必使你寻见；你若离弃他，他必永远丢弃你。
28.en: You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for the LORD searches all hearts, and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever.

28.zh: 你当谨慎，因耶和华拣选你建造殿宇作为圣所。你当刚强去行。」
28.en: Take heed now, for the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong, and do it.”

28.zh: 大卫将[殿的]游廊、旁屋、府库、楼房、内殿，和施恩所的样式指示他儿子所罗门，
28.en: Then David gave to Solomon his son the plans for the porch of the temple, for its houses, for its treasuries, for its upper rooms, for its inner rooms, for the place of the mercy seat;

28.zh: 又将被灵感动所得的样式，就是耶和华　神殿的院子、周围的房屋、殿的府库，和圣物府库的一切样式都指示他；
28.en: and the plans of all that he had by the Spirit, for the courts of the LORD’s house, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of God’s house, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;

28.zh: 又指示他祭司和利未人的班次与耶和华殿里各样的工作，并耶和华殿里一切器皿的样式，
28.en: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, for all the work of the service of the LORD’s house, and for all the vessels of service in the LORD’s house—

28.zh: 以及各样应用金器的分两和各样应用银器的分两，
28.en: of gold by weight for the gold for all vessels of every kind of service, for all the vessels of silver by weight, for all vessels of every kind of service;

28.zh: 金灯台和金灯的分两，银灯台和银灯的分两，轻重各都合宜；
28.en: by weight also for the lamp stands of gold, and for its lamps, of gold, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps; and for the lamp stands of silver, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps, according to the use of every lamp stand;

28.zh: 陈设饼金桌子的分两，银桌子的分两，
28.en: and the gold by weight for the tables of show bread, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver;

28.zh: 精金的肉叉子、盘子，和爵的分两，各金碗与各银碗的分两，
28.en: and the forks, the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;

28.zh: 精金香坛的分两，并用金子做基路伯；基路伯张开[翅膀]，遮掩耶和华的约柜。
28.en: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and gold for the plans for the chariot, and the cherubim that spread out and cover the ark of the LORD’s covenant.

28.zh: [大卫]说：「这一切工作的样式都是耶和华用手划出来使我明白的。」
28.en: “All this”, David said, “I have been made to understand in writing from the LORD’s hand, even all the works of this pattern.”

28.zh: 大卫又对他儿子所罗门说：「你当刚强壮胆去行！不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。因为耶和华　神就是我的　神，与你同在；他必不撇下你，也不丢弃你，直到耶和华殿的工作都完毕了。
28.en: David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the LORD God, even my God, is with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you, until all the work for the service of the LORD’s house is finished.

28.zh: 有祭司和利未人的各班，为要办理　神殿各样的事，又有灵巧的人在各样的工作上乐意帮助你；并有众首领和众民一心听从你的命令。」
28.en: Behold, there are the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of God’s house. Every willing man who has skill for any kind of service shall be with you in all kinds of work. Also the captains and all the people will be entirely at your command.”

29.zh: 大卫王对会众说：「我儿子所罗门是　神特选的，还年幼娇嫩；这工程甚大，因这殿不是为人，乃是为耶和华　神建造的。
29.en: David the king said to all the assembly, “Solomon my son, whom alone God has chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.

29.zh: 我为我　神的殿已经尽力，预备金子做金器，银子做银器，铜做铜器，铁做铁器，木做木器，还有红玛瑙可镶嵌的宝石，彩石和一切的宝石，并许多汉白玉。
29.en: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for the things of gold, the silver for the things of silver, the bronze for the things of bronze, iron for the things of iron, and wood for the things of wood, also onyx stones, stones to be set, stones for inlaid work of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

29.zh: 且因我心中爱慕我　神的殿，就在预备建造圣殿的材料之外，又将我自己积蓄的金银献上，建造我　神的殿，
29.en: In addition, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, since I have a treasure of my own of gold and silver, I give it to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house:

29.zh: 就是俄斐金三千他连得、精炼的银子七千他连得，以贴殿墙。
29.en: even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, with which to overlay the walls of the houses;

29.zh: 金子做金器，银子做银器，并借匠人的手制造一切。今日有谁乐意将自己献给耶和华呢？」
29.en: of gold for the things of gold, and of silver for the things of silver, and for all kinds of work to be made by the hands of artisans. Who then offers willingly to consecrate himself today to the LORD?”

29.zh: 于是，众族长和以色列各支派的首领、千夫长、百夫长，并监管王工的官长，都乐意献上。
29.en: Then the princes of the fathers’ households, and the princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers over the king’s work, offered willingly;

29.zh: 他们为　神殿的使用献上金子五千他连得零一万达利克，银子一万他连得，铜一万八千他连得，铁十万他连得。
29.en: and they gave for the service of God’s house of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand darics, of silver ten thousand talents, of bronze eighteen thousand talents, and of iron one hundred thousand talents.

29.zh: 凡有[宝]石的都交给革顺人耶歇，送入耶和华殿的府库。
29.en: People with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the LORD’s house, under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

29.zh: 因这些人诚心乐意献给耶和华，百姓就欢喜，大卫王也大大欢喜。
29.en: Then the people rejoiced, because they offered willingly, because with a perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD; and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

29.zh: 所以，大卫在会众面前称颂耶和华说：「耶和华—我们的父，以色列的　神是应当称颂，直到永永远远的！
29.en: Therefore David blessed the LORD before all the assembly; and David said, “You are blessed, LORD, the God of Israel our father, forever and ever.

29.zh: 耶和华啊，尊大、能力、荣耀、强胜、威严都是你的；凡天上地下的都是你的；国度也是你的，并且你为至高，为万有之首。
29.en: Yours, LORD, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and on the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, LORD, and you are exalted as head above all.

29.zh: 丰富尊荣都从你而来，你也治理万物。在你手里有大能大力，使人尊大强盛都出于你。
29.en: Both riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all! In your hand is power and might! It is in your hand to make great, and to give strength to all!

29.zh: 我们的　神啊，现在我们称谢你，赞美你荣耀之名！
29.en: Now therefore, our God, we thank you and praise your glorious name.

29.zh: 「我算什么，我的民算什么，竟能如此乐意奉献？因为万物都从你而来，我们把从你而得的献给你。
29.en: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from you, and we have given you of your own.

29.zh: 我们在你面前是客旅，是寄居的，与我们列祖一样。我们在世的日子如影儿，不能长存。
29.en: For we are strangers before you and foreigners, as all our fathers were. Our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no remaining.

29.zh: 耶和华—我们的　神啊，我们预备这许多材料，要为你的圣名建造殿宇，都是从你而来，都是属你的。
29.en: LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build you a house for your holy name comes from your hand, and is all your own.

29.zh: 我的　神啊，我知道你察验人心，喜悦正直；我以正直的心乐意献上这一切物。现在我喜欢见你的民在这里都乐意奉献与你。
29.en: I know also, my God, that you try the heart and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things. Now I have seen with joy your people, who are present here, offer willingly to you.

29.zh: 耶和华—我们列祖亚伯拉罕、以撒、以色列的　神啊，求你使你的民常存这样的心思意念，坚定他们的心归向你，
29.en: LORD, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this desire forever in the thoughts of the heart of your people, and prepare their heart for you;

29.zh: 又求你赐我儿子所罗门诚实的心，遵守你的命令、法度、律例，成就这一切的事，用我所预备的建造殿宇。」
29.en: and give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision.”

29.zh: 大卫对全会众说：「你们应当称颂耶和华—你们的　神。」于是会众称颂耶和华—他们列祖的　神，低头拜耶和华与王。
29.en: Then David said to all the assembly, “Now bless the LORD your God!” All the assembly blessed the LORD, the God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads and prostrated themselves before the LORD and the king.

29.zh: 次日，他们向耶和华献[平安]祭和燔祭，就是献公牛一千只，公绵羊一千只，羊羔一千只，并同献的奠祭；又为以色列众人献许多的祭。那日，他们在耶和华面前吃喝，大大欢乐。
29.en: They sacrificed sacrifices to the LORD and offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the next day after that day, even one thousand bulls, one thousand rams, and one thousand lambs, with their drink offerings and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel,

29.zh: 他们奉耶和华的命再膏大卫的儿子所罗门作王，又膏撒督作祭司。
29.en: and ate and drank before the LORD on that day with great gladness. They made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him before the LORD to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.

29.zh: 于是所罗门坐在耶和华所赐的位上，接续他父亲大卫作王，万事亨通；以色列众人也都听从他。
29.en: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.

29.zh: 众首领和勇士，并大卫王的众子，都顺服所罗门王。
29.en: All the princes, the mighty men, and also all of the sons of King David submitted themselves to Solomon the king.

29.zh: 耶和华使所罗门在以色列众人眼前甚为尊大，极其威严，胜过在他以前的以色列王。
29.en: The LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and gave to him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

29.zh: 耶西的儿子大卫作以色列众人的王，
29.en: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

29.zh: 作王共四十年：在希伯 作王七年，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。
29.en: The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

29.zh: 他年纪老迈，日子满足，享受丰富、尊荣，就死了。他儿子所罗门接续他作王。
29.en: He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.

29.zh: 大卫王始终的事都写在先见撒母耳的书上和先知拿单并先见迦得的书上。
29.en: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Samuel the seer, and in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the history of Gad the seer,

29.zh: 他的国事和他的勇力，以及他和以色列并列国所经过的事都写在这书上。
29.en: with all his reign and his might, and the events that involved him, Israel, and all the kingdoms of the lands.
